About Front Inc
---------------

Established in 2002, Front is a specialist façade consulting practice of 50 staff, based in New York City, San Francisco Bay Area, Hong Kong and London.  
  
We are a cross-disciplinary group of creative individuals with professional backgrounds in Architecture, Structural Engineering, and Mechanical Engineering. We work with owners, architects, engineers, construction managers, contractors, and fabricators in a collaborative fashion. We are specialists in architectural façade systems for new construction, including curtain wall, bespoke cladding systems and the use of structural glass and related lightweight structures. Our portfolio of work ranges in size and complexity and includes large-scale high-rise curtain wall projects, public and cultural institutions, additions to historically sensitive sites, as well as custom designed work for private residences and artists.  
  
Our design and technical consulting work includes façade system design and optimization, detailing, and analysis, value engineering, guidance through the procurement and bidding process, and review during fabrication, mock-up, testing, and construction. We will consider the criteria for structural and environmental performance and recommend mock-up and test methods. We work with a variety of building systems and a wide palette of materials, including steel, aluminium, copper, titanium, concrete, stone, glass, and other composites.  
  
A key aspect of our collaborative work process is our ability to utilize 3D analysis of façade systems to review, interrogate, manipulate, and analyze building information as three-dimensional data. The use of these 3D tools can add significant benefits to system design efficiency and to improving the cost control process and project coordination, often bringing clarity and legibility to complex design problems.  
  
Drawing upon our first-hand experience with the successful execution of many original and challenging architectural projects and our specialist knowledge of the facade industry, we can assist in the evaluation of qualified bidders, and advise on procurement methods, constructability of systems, value engineering options, and how best to meet the project schedule and budget.  
  
At Front, we engage fully with our creative partners in the design and construction industry. We provide strategic advice through intensive collaboration to realize innovative projects across the globe. As active and open-minded participants in the design process, our goal is to find practical ways to realize the design intent.  
  
Our global outlook and experience are the foundation of our practice.

About Brendan Gregg

Brendan Gregg is a distinguished Fellow at Intel Corporation, where he spearheads groundbreaking initiatives in performance analysis across a diverse range of computing technologies, including AI, GPUs, CPUs, and cloud computing. With a rich background in performance engineering, previously honed at Netflix, Brendan has developed a keen expertise in performance design, evaluation, analysis, and tuning. His work is characterized by a holistic approach to understanding system performance—from applications down to the metal—enabling developers and engineers to optimize their systems efficiently.  
  
At Intel, Brendan is at the forefront of pioneering new capabilities in performance and security through the innovative use of eBPF (extended Berkeley Packet Filter). This powerful technology allows for dynamic tracing and monitoring of system performance, providing insights that were previously difficult to obtain. His commitment to advancing performance analysis is evident in his support for the Intel DevCloud, a public cloud platform that allows users to experiment with the latest Intel technologies and tools, fostering a community of developers eager to push the boundaries of performance optimization.  
  
Brendan’s contributions extend beyond his current role; he is also a prolific author, having penned influential texts such as "Systems Performance" and "BPF Performance Tools," which serve as essential resources for professionals in the field. His recognition, including the USENIX LISA Outstanding Achievement award, underscores his impact on the industry. With a skill set that encompasses distributed systems, performance tuning, and advanced technologies like ZFS and SystemTap, Brendan Gregg continues to shape the future of computing performance, empowering others to achieve excellence in their own projects.

About Vector Airport Systems
----------------------------

Vector is a Virginia-based company that provides aircraft identification and automated landing fee billing and collection systems. The company was formed in order to respond to an RFP for an automated identification, and landing fee billing and collection system at Massport’s Hanscom Field. Vector won that contract and has continued to expand on the capabilities first developed for that project, including the integration of multiple aircraft and flight track data sources in order to create the most complete operations database possible. Vector now has systems at more than a dozen airports worldwide including Papua New Guinea and Puerto Rico.  
  
Vector has been investing significantly over the past several years in building high-ROI products, adding key-team members and software developers, and focusing on client satisfaction. To date, we have installed our systems at more than 50 airports across the US and overseas - both commercial and general aviation – giving Vector the wide base of experience to confidently succeed at complex projects.  
  
In response to requests from existing clients, Vector recently developed a noise and operations monitoring system (VNOMS), a simple to use, inexpensive system that integrated the data from our aircraft identification system with flight tracking data. VNOMS is the first operations monitoring system that includes the ability to automatically fuse data from a camera-based aircraft identification system with flight track data, creating the best quality operations database for an operations monitoring system, especially useful at general aviation airports.

About Oxford University Clinical Research Unit
----------------------------------------------

The Oxford University Clinical Research Unit (OUCRU) is a large-scale clinical and public health research unit with site offices in Viet Nam, Indonesia, and Nepal.  
  
Part of the Centre for Tropical Medicine and Global Health at the University of Oxford (UK), OUCRU was first established in Ho Chi Minh City in 1991, hosted by the Hospital for Tropical Diseases (HTD), Viet Nam. In 2003, OUCRU-NP was established in Kathmandu, Nepal, hosted by Patan Hospital and the Patan Academy of Health Sciences. OUCRU Hanoi was established in 2006 in partnership with the National Hospital of Tropical Diseases (NHTD), Viet Nam. In 2008, the Eijkman-Oxford Clinical Research Unit (EOCRU) was established in Jakarta, Indonesia, in partnership with the Eijkman Institute for Molecular Biology and Faculty of Medicine University of Indonesia.  
  
Our vision is to have a local, regional and global impact on health by leading a locally-driven research programme on infectious diseases in Southeast Asia.  
  
Our research programme covers clinical and laboratory research with hospital and community-based patient populations, including epidemiology, immunology, host and pathogen genetics, molecular biology, microbiology and virology, mathematical modelling, bioinformatics, biostatistics, and social science. This work is supported by an extensive clinical trials unit and data management centre compliant with national and international regulations and comprehensive management, finance, public engagement, and administrative support offices.  
  
OUCRU receives considerable support from Wellcome Trust as part of the Africa and Asia Programmes. Together with our partners, we have led a highly successful effort in enhancing the infrastructure and capacity to perform clinical trials and basic scientific research in Viet Nam, Indonesia, and Nepal.

About Georgia Department of Public Health
-----------------------------------------

The Georgia Department of Public Health (DPH) is the lead state government agency in preventing disease, injury and disability; promoting health and well-being; and preparing for and responding to disasters from a health perspective. In 2011, the General Assembly restored DPH to its own state agency after more than 30 years of consolidation with other departments. At the state level, DPH functions through numerous divisions, sections, programs and offices. Locally, DPH funds and collaborates with Georgia's 159 county health departments and 18 public health districts. Through the changes, the mission has remained constant – to protect the lives of all Georgians.  
  
Today, DPH’s main functions include: Health Promotion and Disease Prevention, Maternal and Child Health, Infectious Disease and Immunization, Environmental Health, Epidemiology, Emergency Preparedness and Response, Emergency Medical Services, Pharmacy, Nursing, Volunteer Health Care, the Office of Health Equity, Vital Records, and the State Public Health Laboratory.  
  
For more information about DPH, visit www.dph.ga.gov.

About American Board of Obesity Medicine
----------------------------------------

The American Board of Obesity Medicine (ABOM) serves the public and the field of obesity medicine by maintaining standards for assessment and credentialing physicians. Certification as an ABOM diplomate signifies specialized knowledge in the practice of obesity medicine and distinguishes a physician as having achieved competency in obesity care.  
  
Obesity Medicine Physician  
  
An obesity medicine physician is a physician with expertise in the field of obesity medicine. This field of medicine requires competency in and a thorough understanding of the treatment of obesity and the genetic, biologic, environmental, social, and behavioral factors that contribute to obesity.  
  
The obesity medicine physician employs therapeutic interventions including diet, physical activity, behavioral change, and pharmacotherapy.  
  
The obesity medicine physician utilizes a comprehensive approach, and may include additional resources such as nutritionists, exercise physiologists, psychologists and bariatric surgeons as indicated to achieve optimal results.  
  
Additionally, the obesity medicine physician maintains competency in providing pre- peri- and post-surgical care of bariatric surgery patients, promotes the prevention of obesity, and advocates for those who suffer from obesity.

About Annexon Biosciences
-------------------------

Annexon (Nasdaq: ANNX) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing a new class of complement medicines for patients with classical complement-mediated autoimmune, neurodegenerative, and ophthalmic disorders of the body, brain, and eye. The company’s pipeline is based on its platform technology addressing a broad spectrum of well-researched classical complement-mediated autoimmune and neurodegenerative diseases triggered by aberrant activation of C1q, the initiating molecule of the classical complement pathway. Annexon is advancing a portfolio of innovative product candidates designed to block the activity of C1q and the entire classical complement pathway: ANX005 (intravenous administration), ANX007 (intravitreal administration), and ANX009 (subcutaneous administration). Annexon is deploying a disciplined, biomarker-driven strategy designed to improve the probability of technical success of its portfolio. For more information, visit www.annexonbio.com.

The House of Garrard is the longest serving jeweller in the world. Its origins can be traced back to 1735, when Frederick, Prince of Wales became its first royal patron. His order marked the start of a long relationship with the British royal family, formalised in 1843 when Queen Victoria appointed the House as the first official Crown Jeweller. Iconic jewels have been created for each successive generation, including the Duchess of Cambridge’s sapphire cluster engagement ring. Silverware and trophies have also been commissioned over the centuries, among them the Royal Ascot Gold Cup. This rich past informs a creative present where heritage and design combine to bring out the beauty of the precious stone or metal. From tiaras to trophies and rings to regalia, every Garrard creation bears the quintessentially British hallmark of history, craft and quality.

About Jonah Evans

Jonah Evans is a dedicated App Developer at NatureTracking, where he merges his passion for wildlife conservation with cutting-edge technology. In his current role, Jonah is instrumental in developing and maintaining the NatureTracking.com website, which serves as a vital resource for wildlife enthusiasts, researchers, and conservationists alike. His expertise in wildlife biology and ecology informs the design and functionality of the site, ensuring that users have access to the most accurate and up-to-date information on animal tracking and identification.  
  
One of Jonah's key projects is the iTrack Wildlife smartphone field guides, which have revolutionized how individuals engage with nature. These apps provide users with intuitive tools for identifying animal tracks and signs, enhancing their outdoor experiences while promoting environmental awareness. By integrating GIS technology and ecological principles into the app's design, Jonah has created a user-friendly platform that appeals to both novice nature lovers and seasoned wildlife biologists.  
  
In addition to his work at NatureTracking, Jonah serves as the State Mammalogist for Texas Parks and Wildlife, where he applies his extensive knowledge of wildlife conservation and ecological restoration to manage and protect Texas's diverse mammal populations. His role as a Track and Sign Evaluator for CyberTracker Conservation further underscores his commitment to advancing wildlife tracking methodologies. Through his travels across the country, Jonah shares his insights and expertise, fostering a deeper understanding of wildlife conservation and the importance of preserving natural habitats. With a unique blend of skills in iOS development, environmental science, and ecological restoration, Jonah Evans continues to make significant contributions to the fields of wildlife tracking and conservation technology.

The American Egyptian Youth Network (AEYN) is a U.S.-based nonprofit, nonpartisan organization recently launched by first generation Egyptian-Americans. With almost three-quarters of Egypt’s population under the age of 35, AEYN is driven by a profound awareness that Egypt’s future is ultimately tied to the fate of its youth. At the same time, AEYN appreciates the vital importance of cross-cultural dialogue and interaction in an increasingly interconnected world. About Cassi Davis

Cassi Davis is a highly talented and versatile American actress known for her exceptional comedic timing and captivating on-screen presence. With a career spanning over three decades, she has become an iconic figure in the entertainment industry, earning the adoration and respect of fans and peers alike. Davis is best recognized for her memorable role as Ella Payne in the hit television series "Tyler Perry's House of Payne," where she showcased her comedic prowess and stole the hearts of viewers worldwide.  
  
Born on July 31, 1964, in Holly Springs, Mississippi, Cassi Davis discovered her love for acting at an early age. Davis honed her acting skills at the prestigious Spelman College in Atlanta, Georgia, where she earned a Bachelor of Arts degree in Speech and Drama. Following her graduation, she further honed her craft by attending the University of Georgia and the Alabama State University Theatre Program.  
  
Davis began her professional acting career in the late 1980s, appearing in small stage productions and various television commercials. Her breakout role came in 1996 when she starred alongside "Madea" creator Tyler Perry in his first play, "I Know I've Been Changed." This collaboration marked the beginning of a long and fruitful partnership between Davis and Perry, as they continued to work together on numerous stage plays and films.  
  
In 2006, Davis secured her breakthrough role that catapulted her to widespread recognition and success. She was cast as Ella Payne, the lovable, sassy, and quick-witted matriarch in the popular television series "Tyler Perry's House of Payne." Davis brought an incredible blend of humor, warmth, and relatability to the character, instantly resonating with audiences. Her impeccable comedic timing and infectious energy made Ella Payne one of the most beloved television characters of the time.  
  
During her tenure on "House of Payne," Davis's extraordinary talent earned her multiple accolades and nominations. In 2008 and 2009, she won the NAACP Image Award for Outstanding Actress in a Comedy Series, solidifying her standing as one of the industry's finest performers.  
  
Aside from her television success, Davis has also made significant contributions to the silver screen. In 2008, she reprised her role as Ella Payne in the film adaptation of "Tyler Perry's House of Payne." The movie received critical acclaim and further solidified Davis's status as a talented and versatile actress capable of seamlessly transitioning between mediums.  
  
Despite her incredible success, Davis remains humble and down-to-earth, approaching each role with dedication and passion. She has often expressed gratitude for the opportunities she has been given, recognizing the importance of hard work and perseverance in the entertainment industry. Davis's commitment to her craft is evident in her ability to bring depth and authenticity to every character she portrays.  
  
In addition to her work with Tyler Perry, Davis has also appeared in various other television shows and films, showcasing her versatility as an actress. Her notable credits include the hit comedy series "Living Single," "ER," "The PJ's," and "Madea's Big Happy Family," to name a few. Her ability to effortlessly capture the essence of each character continues to captivate audiences, making every appearance a memorable one.  
  
Off-screen, Davis is known for her philanthropy and involvement in various charitable organizations. She is a strong advocate for empowering and uplifting the African American community and has actively supported initiatives aimed at improving education, health, and opportunities for underprivileged individuals.  
  
Cassi Davis's immense talent, infectious laughter, and genuine kindness have left an indelible mark on the entertainment industry. Her ability to bring laughter to even the most challenging circumstances and her commitment to her craft have firmly established her as a beloved figure in the hearts of her fans. With her incredible body of work and unwavering dedication, Davis continues to inspire aspiring actors and entertain audiences worldwide with her unmatched talent and undeniable charm.

Almost overnight, Cannabis has become a legal, legitimate business and a multi-billion dollar industry. Not since we decided to get into the business, years ago – when we started planning, lobbying, and building a strategy. A strategy rooted in quality, not speed or quantity. While corners are being cut across the cannabis industry, we’ve stayed true to our promise of doing things the right way – because, as time tells, the right way is the lasting way, and we’re planning on sticking around.  
  
From the beginning, we’ve understood the importance of controlling the entire process of our products from start to finish. We’re not merely a storefront selling products we know nothing about. Everything in our stores we’ve grown, hand-trimmed, packaged, and put on our shelves. Because, as the saying goes, if you want something done right, you do it yourself. That’s why we’ve spent the last two years building the most advanced grow facility in the industry and recruiting the best, most experienced team to run it. Every single one of our products goes through rigorous testing that’s unparalleled in the industry, as we hold them to the highest standards – your standards.  
  
We’re bringing you cannabis you can trust. Whether you’re familiar with cannabis or not, our personalized customer experience has been designed to guide you in finding the perfect products. Because we believe quality is everything – a quality experience, a quality product, a quality team and a quality result. And while that’s the way it should always be, it’s cannabis in a new light.

About Rush Memorial Hospital
----------------------------

The first hospital in Rushville was a private hospital built by Dr. John Sexton in 1892. It was built on Fifth Street on a lot adjacent to the Sexton Home at Fifth and Main Street. The hospital was one of the first in southern Indiana and was the only hospital between Hamilton, Ohio, and Indianapolis, Indiana.  
  
In 1902, this small private hospital was replaced with a two-story building on the same location. When Dr. Sexton retired in 1929, he sold the building to the city.  
  
Upon his return from military service, Dr. Frank Green, Sr., opened a six-bed hospital in 1919, above the office which he shared with his brother, Dr. Charles Green, DDS. In 1944, during World War II, the Green Hospital closed.  
  
The present Rush Memorial Hospital was opened in 1950. This limestone building included 52 beds and 16 bassinets. In 1973, the hospital completed an expansion project that consisted of an emergency department, modernized ancillary service areas, and a kitchen.  
  
Today, Rush Memorial Hospital is a 25-bed Critical Access Hospital with 5-clinics serving Rush County. Rush Memorial Hospital is designated a a premier workplace in the community and has revived Healthcare's Most Wired 2013, 2014, 105 and HIMSS Analytics Stage 6 accreditation. Rush Memorial Hospital continues to build a health network in aim of providing patients with the best service experience possible.

What types of services does Fayette Regional Health System offer?

How can I schedule an appointment for physical therapy?

To schedule an appointment for physical therapy at Fayette Regional, you can call our Physical Therapy department directly or visit our website to request an appointment online. What should I expect during my first visit to the Cancer Center?

During your first visit to the Cancer Center at Fayette Regional, you will meet with a specialized oncologist who will review your medical history and discuss your diagnosis. Our team will explain your treatment options and work with you to develop a personalized care plan that addresses your specific needs and preferences.

Do you offer services for pediatric patients?

What types of cosmetic procedures are available?

Fayette Regional Health System offers a range of facial and cosmetic procedures designed to enhance your appearance and boost your confidence. Our services include non-invasive treatments such as Botox and dermal fillers, as well as surgical options like facelifts and eyelid surgery. We know the biggest problem facing the construction industry is inefficiency, so we work hard to eliminate inefficiency every day. We use creativity and attention to detail to dig deeper than the drawings. We don’t ask, “How do we build this?” We ask, “How do we build this better?”

What types of companies does McKinney Capital invest in?

McKinney Capital exclusively invests in Field Services companies. This includes businesses that provide services directly at customer locations, such as maintenance, repair, installation, and other operational support. Our focus is on companies that demonstrate strong growth potential and operational efficiency within the field services sector.

What is the investment philosophy of McKinney Capital?

At McKinney Capital, our investment philosophy centers around long-term partnerships with our portfolio companies. We seek to identify and support businesses that align with our values of integrity, innovation, and operational excellence. Our goal is to provide not just capital, but also strategic guidance and resources to help our partners achieve sustainable growth.

How does McKinney Capital support its portfolio companies?

McKinney Capital provides comprehensive support to its portfolio companies through strategic guidance, operational expertise, and access to a network of industry contacts. We work closely with management teams to identify growth opportunities, streamline operations, and enhance overall business performance. Our hands-on approach ensures that we are actively involved in the success of our investments.

What industries fall under the category of Field Services?

Field Services encompass a wide range of industries, including but not limited to utilities, telecommunications, construction, maintenance, and repair services. Essentially, any business model that delivers services directly to customers in their locations qualifies as a Field Services company. McKinney Capital is particularly interested in businesses that leverage technology to improve service delivery and customer satisfaction.

What is the typical investment size for McKinney Capital?

While the investment size can vary based on the specific needs and potential of each company, McKinney Capital typically invests in the range of $1 million to $10 million. We tailor our investment approach to align with the growth stage and strategic objectives of the businesses we partner with, ensuring that our support is both meaningful and impactful.

How can a Field Services company approach McKinney Capital for investment?

Field Services companies interested in exploring investment opportunities with McKinney Capital can reach out through our website's contact form or directly via email. We encourage potential partners to provide a brief overview of their business, including their growth plans and any specific challenges they are facing. Our team will review the information and follow up to discuss potential collaboration.

About Dr Rissy's Writing
------------------------

Dr. Rissy’s Professional Writers for Hire  
Welcome to Dr. Rissy’s Writing,  
  
I am so glad that you are here. Let me tell you about myself and what I know my team can do for you. So, getting noticed in real life isn’t easy. Getting noticed online, on this global internet can be daunting.  
  
Everyone who has interviewed for a job knows that, even with the right shoes and the best attitude, you are not going to get the job if you don’t have good content (your resume, your school transcripts, your references, etc.). The same goes for online businesses and blogs. Now more than ever, eCommerce and blogging websites are bringing small businesses and other companies into the limelight. There is a lot of competition. If you want your business to succeed online, you need more than just a pretty website and a big idea. You need words. High-quality content is what drives everything including search engine results and persuading customers to come back to your website. Our team of experienced website content writers will add value to your website.  
  
Not all successful eCommerce sites or blogs are run by professional website content writers, those of us with a passion for writing, so there is no need to worry that you are doomed to fail if you aren’t the best writer. Thankfully, there are thousands of freelance blog writers for hire. But how do you know who to trust and who not to? The best option is to look to people and organizations who have a documented passion and success in the writing field. Dr. Rissy’s Writing is the perfect team of professional writers to hire for your eCommerce site or blog. When you work with us, your blog’s content will not only be exciting and engaging; it will draw in readers and customers from all over the world!

My writing has appeared in countless periodicals and online publications including Entertainment Weekly, Hello Giggles, Nerd Approved, Grunge, and My Neon Green Notebook. About Philmont Scout Ranch
--------------------------

Delivering Wilderness and Learning Adventures that Last a Lifetime.  
  
Philmont Scout Ranch is the Boy Scouts of America's largest national High Adventure Base. Its 36 staffed camps and 55 trail camps provide an unforgettable adventure in the high country along hundreds of miles of rugged, rocky trails.  
  
Born in 1938 as Philturn Rockymountain Scoutcamp, today's Philmont Scout Ranch is a bustling center for high adventure and training. Youth and adults take advantage of the Ranch's camping, training and work programs. Most activity takes place during the summer, but Philmont also offers Autumn Adventure and Winter Adventure programs.  
  
More than 1 million Scouts, Venturers, and leaders have experienced the adventure of Philmont since the first camping season in 1939. Throughout its existence, conscientious attention to low-impact camping techniques has helped maintain the Ranch's wilderness.  
  
The area surrounding the Ranch is rich with history, from the Native Americans who made this arid land their home to the land barons of the 19th century. The town of Cimarron boasts a number of historical buildings, including the St. James Hotel, the site of at least 26 killings during Cimarron's wilder days.

Born on August 16, 1996, in Columbia, Missouri, Sophie developed a love for basketball at a young age. Her father, Bill, was a standout football player for the University of Missouri, and her mother, Carla, played basketball at Missouri State University.  
  
Cunningham's basketball journey began in high school, where she played for Rock Bridge High School in Columbia. During her high school career, she quickly emerged as one of the top players in the state. Her impressive performances attracted the attention of college basketball coaches across the country.  
  
After a successful high school career, Sophie decided to stay close to home and committed to the University of Missouri to play for the Tigers. Her impact was immediate, as she became an integral part of the team and was named the SEC Freshman of the Year. Cunningham's ability to score in a variety of ways, from deep three-pointers to slashing drives to the basket, showcased her versatility on the court.  
  
As her collegiate career progressed, Sophie continued to dominate the competition. Known for her fearless playing style, she became a reliable scoring option and a leader for her team. She consistently put up impressive numbers, averaging around 17 points per game throughout her time at Missouri.  
  
Cunningham's leadership qualities were evident both on and off the court. Her competitive spirit and determination to win inspired her teammates to rise to the occasion. In her junior year, she led the Tigers to their first NCAA Tournament appearance since 2006, solidifying her place as one of the best players in the program's history.  
  
After a successful collegiate career, Sophie took her talents to the professional level. In the 2019 WNBA Draft, she was selected as the 13th overall pick by the Phoenix Mercury. Her transition to the professional ranks was seamless, and she quickly made her mark in the league.  
  
Playing alongside WNBA legends such as Diana Taurasi and Brittney Griner, Cunningham continued to develop her skills and make an impact on the court. Her versatility as a scorer and her willingness to do the little things to help her team succeed made her an invaluable asset.  
  
Off the court, Sophie is known for her philanthropic work and dedication to giving back to the community. She has actively taken part in various charitable initiatives, using her platform as a professional athlete to make a positive impact.  
  
In addition to her basketball career, Cunningham is a strong advocate for gender equality and women's empowerment. She has spoken out about the importance of equal opportunities and breaking down barriers for women in sports. By using her voice and platform, she hopes to inspire young girls to pursue their dreams and strive for greatness.  
  
Sophie Cunningham's journey from a young basketball enthusiast to an accomplished professional athlete is a testament to her hard work, determination, and love for the game. Three decades ago, there was an exigent call for diagnostic facilities in West and Outer Delhi. This is why 'Janta X-Ray Clinic' was established in 1978. Today, medicine is advancing by leaps and bounds. New technologies and newer tools are being developed for diagnosis and treatment of diseases. Many new medical and diagnostic centers have sprung up in the last decade but, most of these do not have the resources and infrastructure to provide the latest in technology to the patients.Keeping one step ahead 'JANTA X-RAY CLINIC' has decided to offer all these latest tech based diagnostic services under the name and style of STAR IMAGING AND PATH LAB at our Tilak Nagar Center at 4B/4 and 4B/5, New Delhi. Star imaging and Path Lab is providing services related to Open MRI, CT Scan, 4D Volumetric Ultrasound, Whole Body DEXA Bone Densitometer, Digital Mammography, Digital OPG, Digital X-Rays, Auto-Analyzer for Biochemistry, Immunoassay Analyser for special tests, Computerized ECG and much more to West Delhi under the name of your own M/S Janta X-Ray Clinic Tilak Nagar. Dr R A Gupta, the chairman of the company is fully committed to provide the people of Delhi with most modern diagnostic facilities under these firms.We are a team of dedicated professionals engaged in providing ultra-modern diagnostic facilities to the people of Delhi. In the highly specialized world of medicine today, one needs specific qualifications and experience for different fields such as radiology, pathology, anesthesia etc. At Star Imaging & Path Lab, we have full time Radiologists, Pathologists, Anesthetists, Biochemists, Microbiologist, Gynaecologist and wellness consultant each with ample experience in their respective field. Total quality management and superb efficiency are the core of success in any field esp. diagnostics. In our team, we have highly experienced people who take care of the day-to-day management leaving the specialized doctors free to concentrate on diagnosis

The university's mission is to bridge the gap between academia and industry, particularly in the fields of science and technology, thereby addressing the emerging needs of Vietnam's development landscape.  
  
USTH is committed to creating synergies between research and education, enhancing university-industry linkages, and promoting innovative public-private partnerships in higher education. This approach not only enriches the academic experience for students but also equips them with the skills and knowledge necessary to thrive in a rapidly evolving job market. The university's curriculum is designed to be responsive to industry demands, ensuring that graduates are well-prepared to contribute to Vietnam's socio-economic growth.  
  
For those interested in the faculty and academic staff, the Hanoi University of Sciences and Technologies boasts a diverse and highly qualified teachers list, comprising experts from various scientific disciplines. This talented group of educators is dedicated to providing students with a robust educational experience, combining theoretical knowledge with practical applications. As USTH continues to grow and evolve, it remains a vital contributor to the advancement of science and technology in Vietnam, shaping the future of higher education in the region. For more information about the university, visit their official website at http://www.usth.edu.vn.

About Integrity Lab
-------------------

Az Integrity Lab-et azért alapítottuk, mert szeretnénk az általunk képviselt szemlélettel hozzájárulni a minket körülvevő, megváltozott társadalmi és politikai környezet értelmezéséhez és alakításához. Meggyőződésünk, hogy ennek érdekében a megfelelő információk alapján kidolgozott stratégia következetes végrehajtására van szükség – tudatosan megválasztott szövetségesekkel. Olyan projektek megvalósításáért dolgozunk, amelyek hozzájárulnak a demokratikus jogállami keretek megerősítéséhez, az állampolgárok minél tudatosabb és aktívabb részvételéhez, és egy minél szabadabb és sikeresebb társadalom kialakításához. Ennek érdekében működünk együtt azokkal a magyarországi és nemzetközi magán- és közszereplőkkel, akik támogatják e célok megvalósulását, és maguk is új megoldásokat keresnek e célok eléréséhez. /  
We launched Integrity Lab in order to analyze and formulate the social and political environment around us with our own approach. We believe we can achieve this with a strategy based on true information and with the right partners. Our aim is to promote the rulee of law, active citizenship and participation and advance liberty and prosperity. We are cooperating with (and looking for) Hungarian and international allies sharing these ideas and aims in order to find new, innovative solutions to the problems we all have to face – let them be private, civil or political actors.

About Grupo Renascença Multimedia
---------------------------------

Renascença Multimedia Group is a Portuguese media company, with several radio stations, broadcast and online, owned by the Portuguese Catholic Church. The portfolio includes news, music, content creation, digital outlets, distribution, commercial and marketing services.  
  
Renascença started in 1937 and has become the country’s foremost radio group with segmented channels, for example: Renascença (Music/News), RFM (AC music), Mega Hits (CHR) - FM and AM, online, using Web based channels, and recently through mobile and car infotainment Apps.  
  
  
The group evolved to the production of large audience events (concerts, festivals), and supporting, as media sponsor, the biggest shows in Portugal. Owns Intervoz, an advertising company and Genius y Meios, a training and events company.

About SKD Group of Companies
----------------------------

The Sayed Kadhem Al Durazi & Sons Co. BSC (c) started its activity as a small brick factory, founded by the current Chairman, Mr. Sayed Kadhem Mohsin Al Durazi. In 1963 he owned two trucks and started a transportion business. In 1970, the fleet was made bigger when 3 more trucks joined the ranks. In 1972, he added a few heavy machines, thereby laying the foundation for the Sayed Kadhem Al Durazi Contracting Establishment, which was formed in the year 1974.  
  
Thereafter the company started growing and a trading department was added to the group, which started with the agency of Sehan Motor Company. This later gave a way to the Daewoo Motor Company.  
  
At present, the company can boast being the agents of Doosan – Daewoo Heavy industries, one of the largest heavy equipment sellers in the region, Soosan Heavy Industries, Cheng Gong China and such other heavy equipment manufacturing giants.  
  
The company laid the foundation stone for an equipment hiring company in the year 2003. The growth of the division was so tremendous that, “Al Haidariya Heavy Equipment Hiring”, is now a name synonymous with equipment hiring in the region.  
  
Grand Tiger for Industrial and Mechanical, Universal Foundations, Universal Ready Mix Concrete, Universal Block Factory, Universal Agriculture, Universal Real Estate, Single Point for Building Materials, Single Point Aluminium, and Single Point Carpentry, are further development of the company.  
  
Sayed Kadhem Al Durazi& Sons Co. BSC (c), continues its Development march toward a better world, and has been contributing remarkably to the country’s growth, joining hands with the Ministry of Works & Housing, Bahrain Petroleum Company BSC, Aluminium Bahrain BSC (c), GPIC, Ministry of Municipalities and Agricultural Affairs and a lot of other organisations.  
  
In 2005 the company opened its first branch outside Bahrain in Sultanate Of Oman, which now became the main business outside the Kingdom of Bahrain. The globalization of SKD expanded and new branches have been opened in Iraq later in 2016

About TVE
---------

Televisión Española (TVE) es la cadena de televisión pública con una la oferta televisiva más variada y plural del panorama televisión español. Cuenta con centros de producción en Madrid (Prado del Rey, Torrespaña), Barcelona (San Cugat) y Canarias, además de una red de centros territoriales presentes en todas las comunidades, y delegaciones en todo el mundo. Además, la señal de TVE llega a los cinco continentes.  
  
La oferta actual incluye:  
  
• La 1: canal televisivo de referencia de RTVE.  
  
• La 2: su programación es un referente de la cultura, con especial atención a la música, el cine, nuevas tecnologías y medioambiente.  
  
• Canal 24h: primer y único canal todo noticias en español las 24 horas del día los siete días de la semana.  
  
• Clan: canal infantil de referencia para los niños entre los cuatro y los doce años. Su programación valores como la amistad, el respeto, la no discriminación, defensa del medioambiente y hábitos de vida saludables.  
  
• Teledeporte: canal íntegramente dedicado al deporte, donde se atienden tanto los deportes mayoritarios como otros deportes que no se ofrecen en ningún otro lugar (atletismo, la gimnasia, el esquí, la natación, etc.)  
  
• TVE Internacional: está compuesto por cuatro señales que integran una oferta de programación de calidad, completa y diversa, que atiende la demandas de la audiencia internacional, con especial atención a los españoles residentes en el extranjero.  
  
• Star TVE: canal temático en alta definición dirigido al público americano y familiar.

Anna Delvey, dubbed the "socialite scammer," captivated the world with her audacious schemes and extravagant lifestyle. Posing as a wealthy German heiress, she weaved a web of lies, leaving a trail of unpaid bills and shattered dreams in her wake.  
  
Delvey's rise to prominence began in 2013 when she arrived in New York City, armed with a discerning eye for fashion and an insatiable appetite for the high life. She quickly infiltrated the city's elite social circles, effortlessly mingling with wealthy socialites, entrepreneurs, and artists. Delvey's charm and charisma, paired with her impeccable taste in fashion and apparent wealth, helped solidify her image as a jet-setting heiress.  
  
Whispers of her extravagant lifestyle spread like wildfire, as she flaunted designer clothes, attended exclusive events, and dined at the most prestigious restaurants. Delvey even went as far as launching her own "business" – a members-only arts club. Through her alleged connections with influential figures and financial backing from unnamed investors, Delvey managed to secure a prime location in Manhattan and set up the club.  
  
However, it soon became evident that Delvey's glamorous façade was built on nothing more than lies and deceit. As her bills accumulated, she artfully dodged payments by weaving stories of financial discrepancies and banking errors. Her innocuous lies escalated into elaborate tales of complex transactions and offshore accounts. Yet, enough cracks began to surface, and those who crossed her path started to question her authenticity.  
  
Delvey's charade began to unravel when she convinced a staff member at a high-end luxury hotel to process a borrowed credit card payment worth $62,000. The hotel employee, unknowingly aiding in her scheme, later discovered that the payment was invalid. This revelation sparked an investigation that revealed a tangled web of unpaid bills and deceit. Journalists and court documents began to shed light on Delvey's true identity and expose her elaborate cons.  
  
In 2017, Anna Delvey's web of deception finally started to fall apart. She was arrested and charged with multiple counts of theft, grand larceny, and larceny in short cons. Her trial, which became a media sensation, drew attention from around the globe. News outlets and curious onlookers were fascinated by her audacity and the sprawling web of deception she had woven.  
  
Throughout the trial, Delvey maintained her innocence, arguing that she had simply been an ambitious entrepreneur who had fallen on hard times. She claimed that she intended to pay back the money she owed, dismissing the notion that her actions were dishonest. However, the jury saw through her charade and found her guilty on several charges. Delvey was sentenced to four to twelve years in prison and ordered to pay restitution to her victims.  
  
Anna Delvey's extraordinary tale captivated the public and raised questions about privilege, trust, and the allure of the glamorous lifestyle. Her exploits exposed society's vulnerability to deception and shed light on the dark underbelly of the social media age, where appearances can be deceiving. Delvey's story serves as a cautionary tale, reminding us to question the authenticity of those who claim to possess the world while hiding behind a carefully constructed illusion.

About Stephen Hawkins

As the Global Director of Research at More in Common, Stephen Hawkins plays a pivotal role in shaping our understanding of societal divisions and the underlying ideologies that drive them. With a keen focus on how biases and values influence public perception, Stephen leads a team dedicated to conducting rigorous, hypothesis-driven research. His expertise in political science and qualitative research informs the design and execution of mixed-mode studies that provide actionable insights for political parties, unions, and advocacy groups.  
  
Stephen's contributions to the field are exemplified through his co-authorship of influential reports such as "Hidden Tribes" (2018), "The Perception Gap" (2019), "American Fabric" (2020), and "Defusing the History Wars" (2022). These publications have not only garnered over 1,000 media references but have also been instrumental in shaping political discourse, making their way into the platforms of presidential candidates and front-page stories in major outlets like the New York Times. His work emphasizes the importance of understanding the complex tapestry of American society, aiming to bridge divides and foster constructive dialogue.  
  
In addition to his research acumen, Stephen's skills in public relations, strategic communications, and leadership enable him to effectively convey complex findings to diverse audiences. Whether through public speaking engagements or proposal writing, he is committed to translating research into strategies that promote unity and understanding in an increasingly polarized world. As he continues to explore the intersections of ideology and perception, Stephen Hawkins remains a vital voice in the quest for a more cohesive society.

MVP Group International, Inc., headquartered in Elkin, North Carolina, is a distinguished leader in the home fragrance industry, renowned for its rich heritage, family roots, and unwavering commitment to strong values. About Kakao Corp
----------------

‘기술과 사람이 만드는 더 나은 세상’  
  
카카오는 전문화된 인력, 기술력, 콘텐츠와 경쟁력 높은 모바일 트래픽을 바탕으로 글로벌 모바일 및 인터넷 시장에서 혁신적인 서비스를 제공하는 ‘모바일 라이프 플랫폼’ 기업입니다. 일상 생활을 둘러싼 모든 것을 연결하며, 누구나 일상의 혁신을 경험할 수 있도록 노력하고 있습니다.  
  
1995년 설립된 다음커뮤니케이션과 2006년 설립된 카카오가 2014년 10월 1일 합병해 다음카카오로 출범했으며, 2015년 9월 23일 ‘카카오’로 사명을 변경해 모바일 시대를 대표하는 기업으로 나아가고 있습니다.  
  
카카오는 지난 2010년 카카오톡 출시를 시작으로 국내 커뮤니케이션 패러다임을 바꿨으며, 페이나 모빌리티 등 다양한 서비스를 통해 이용자들의 생활 편의를 향상시켰습니다. 또한, 웹툰 및 미디어 영역 내에서 이용자들의 여가를 즐겁고 풍성하게 만들어 주고 있으며 헬스케어 및 AI 기술 투자, ESG 활동 등을 통해 이용자 삶의 새로운 혁신을 이끌며 사람과 세상을 이롭게 하는 카카오만의 가치를 만들어 내고 있습니다.  
  
카카오 크루는 종종 이렇게 묻곤 합니다.  
"카카오스럽나요?"  
앞으로도 우리는 더 나은 세상을 만들기 위해 카카오스러움에서 고민을 시작하고, 답을 찾을 것입니다.

One of his most significant contributions was his portrayal of Goliath, the noble leader of the titular gargoyles in the animated series "Gargoyles." His infectious enthusiasm and genuine love for his craft endear him to fans and colleagues alike. Whether he is sharing behind-the-scenes stories, discussing his creative process, or advocating for social justice, David's authenticity resonates with people beyond the entertainment industry.  
  
To sum it up, Keith David is an unforgettable American actor who has enchanted and captivated audiences for decades. With his commanding voice, physical presence, and undeniable charisma, he effortlessly brings each character he portrays to life. About Pure Business Services
----------------------------

Pure Business Services is one of the UK’s leading business communications providers. We offer a complete suite of communications solutions across Mobile, Fixed Line, ICT, Hosted & Managed Services.  
  
Founded in 2006, Pure was created on the belief that the customer is at the heart of everything we do. Our objective was to build a business that wasn’t the biggest, but the best - somewhere you can be proud to work, renowned for customer satisfaction, being easy to do business with and being a brand our customers can count on and trust.  
  
Our aim is to become the leading business services provider for our customers, suppliers and stakeholders. We will achieve this by providing innovative products, services and solutions and being dedicated to building fantastic relationships, one customer at a time. Our strategy will focus on becoming our customers trusted partner of choice, and our measure for success will be the pride associated with every customer relationship, their personal recommendation and our reputation in the marketplace.  
  
Knowledge, skill, expertise and experience will be important elements of our customer-focused approach. We aim to attract, recruit and retain the best people around and be renowned as the natural home for talent. Our unique DNA; Simple, Effortless and Trusted, will continue to make us a special business to work for, and these core values will underpin our relationships with our colleagues, suppliers, partners and stakeholders.  
  
We are also part of an exclusive group of providers that have been accredited as a Total Communications partner with Vodafone. This means our customers are provided with the best possible experience, as we can benefit from Vodafone’s leading customer service support.  
  
We are Pure.  
Join us on our journey.

About RSL Care
--------------

Bolton Clarke is the new face of RSL Care and RDNS. We’re one of the nation’s largest and most experienced not-for-profit providers of independent living services for older Australians and anyone who needs our help in achieving the best possible quality of life and independence. Our combined experience of over 200 years of compassionate service means we can deliver the highest standard of professional support and clinical care.  
Our services cover 3 main areas – At Home Support; Retirement Living and Residential Aged Care.  
  
Bolton Clarke At Home Support services are designed to help our clients live as independently as possible, wherever they live. We provide hands-on support and assistance covering expert clinical care from our home nurses to professional home assistance services delivered by our care workers.  
  
Bolton Clarke Retirement Living communities are warm and welcoming places where our residents live independently, able to enjoy old interests or discover new ones and with the facilities and support to stay connected to the people and communities important to them.  
  
Our Residential Aged Care communities are staffed 24/7 by a combination of expert nurses and dedicated care workers who can provide help at all times, including emergency situations. Additionally, specialist services like dementia support and palliative care are available, and physiotherapists and other allied health professionals are ready to assist and support our residents.  
  
Bolton Clarke is also proud to have a world renowned in-house research institute and a registered training organisation for our nurses and care workers.  
  
Everything we do has a focus on keeping our clients and residents connected to the people, activities and communities that are important to them.  
  
You can find out more by visiting our website www.boltonclarke.com.au

1986 yılından bu yana saat sektöründe faaliyet gösteren Ersa Saat, dünyaca ünlü saat markalarının Türkiye temsilciliğini üstleniyor. Ersa Saat, distribütörlüğünü yaptığı Casio, Pierre Cardin, Bulova, Swiss Military Hanowa, Timberland ve Reebok markalarını saat tutkunlarının beğenisine sunuyor. Ersa Saat, ithalatçısı olduğu tüm markaların, en son modellerini dünya ülkeleri ile eş zamanlı olarak Türkiye’ye getiriyor ve uluslararası pazarlama stratejilerini ülkemizde de uyguluyor.  
  
Müşteri memnuniyeti ilkesiyle hareket eden Ersa Saat, yetkili bayileri aracılığı ile oluşturduğu yaygın satış ağı sayesinde Türk tüketicileri ile markaları buluşturuyor.  
  
Ersa Saat’in sadece Casio saat satışını gerçekleştirdiği 3 farklı noktada G-Shock mağazası da bulunuyor. Casio, farklı konseptlerde üretilen modelleriyle, her kitleye hitap edebilen, dünya çapında en çok kullanılan saat markası olması özelliğini taşıyor.  
  
İlk günden bu yana rekabet yapısı kuvvetli markaları bünyesine katan Ersa Saat, önümüzdeki dönemler de Dünyaca ünlü markaların temsilciliğini üstlenmeyi hedefliyor. Ersa Saat yaptığı çalışmalarla öncü rol üstlendiği saat sektörünün gelişimine de önemli ölçüde katkı sağlıyor.

After suffering a stroke, James died at his favorite hunting lodge, Theobalds, on March 27, 1625. He was fifty-eight. He was buried on May 5, 1625, under Westminster Abbey's altar, a site from which he had earlier disinterred Queen Elizabeth, and his son succeeded him as King Charles I.

### Did Mary, Queen of Scots have a child?

Born in Edinburgh Castle on 19 June 1566, James was the only son of Mary, Queen of Scots and her second husband, Lord Darnley.

About The News & Observer
-------------------------

The News & Observer traces its roots to a paper called the Sentinal, founded in Raleigh in 1865 and later absorbed by The Observer and then merged with The News. The News & Observer was purchased at auction in 1894 by Josephus Daniels, who later served as secretary of the Navy under President Woodrow Wilson and ambassador to Mexico under Franklin D. Roosevelt. The Daniels family owned the paper until 1995, when it was purchased by McClatchy.  
  
A company with deep roots in the Triangle, The News & Observer Publishing Co. is a modern information company that publishes news and information in both digital and print formats to serve a growing market. Our publications include The News & Observer, one of the nation’s best regional newspapers, and 10 bi-weekly community newspapers. The company launched nando.net, one of the nation’s first internet service providers, in 1994, and today is home to both newsobserver.com and triangle.com, two of the region’s leading websites. We offer comprehensive marketing and advertising solutions that range from cutting-edge rich media online ads to traditional newspaper inserts.  
  
The News & Observer is widely regarded as one of the nation's best regional newspapers and places a strong emphasis on investigative reporting and watchdog journalism. In 1996, the paper was awarded the Pulitzer Prize Gold Medal for Public Service for its work showing how commercial hog farms were affecting the environment and economy in Eastern North Carolina.  
  
Our main office is in downtown Raleigh, NC.  
  
For current positions visit us at http://newsobserver.theresumator.com/apply

About The Daily Tar Heel
------------------------

The Daily Tar Heel is a student-run newspaper that serves the communities of UNC-Chapel Hill and Orange County, N.C.  
  
The Daily Tar Heel is fiscally and editorially independent. DTH Media Corp., a non-profit organization, stopped taking UNC student fees in 1993 and has since been fully funded by its advertising revenue.  
  
The DTH also comprises the 1893 Brand Studio, a student-powered agency that merges traditional storytelling values with modern marketing strategies. We offer a range of services – from graphic design work, to social media guidance, to the creation of paid content.  
  
The Daily Tar Heel's student journalists are solely responsible for all content under the direction of the student editor-in-chief. The Summer 2020 editor-in-chief is Sergio Osnaya-Prieto, and the 2020-2021 editor-in-chief is Anna Pogarcic. The paper’s business operations are governed by a 12-member, student-majority board of directors whose open slots are filled by the board each spring for the next year. At any give time, approximately 250 UNC students can rightly claim to be a member of the DTH staff in news, production design, advertising sales, marketing and customer service positions. The student payroll exceeds $250,000 per year. The company also employs six professional staff in support functions.  
  
The 1893 Brand Studio currently serves about 10 clients and works closely with local community leaders such as the Triangle Community Foundation.

About estiatorio Milos
----------------------

It was in December 1979, when Chef-Owner Costas Spiliadis opened the first Milos estiatorio on Park Avenue, Montreal. The reason seemed obvious to him: the need to elevate the sophistication of Greek cuisine abroad far away from its stereotyped folklore.  
  
'I wanted to change what people thought about Greek cuisine, make sure it's being appreciated and awarded with its rightful place on an international level!'  
  
As a small restaurant, Milos gained the trust of the Montrealers in no time. The menu being always simple and impeccably fresh, drew the attention of the media and food critics from around the world. NY Post has stated in triumph that 'Milos fish could only be fresher if it swam to your plate!'  
  
What was the secret that made Milos stand out? Its focus in finding the purest Mediterranean products and cooking with the freshest ingredients.Through 35 years of intensive research, we have managed to build lasting relationships with growers and small-scale fisheries at the shores of Greece, Cyprus, Morocco, Tunisia, Portugal, flying in our fish and seafood daily by plane! Milos has since then taken the world by storm and opened in 1997 in NYC, in 2004 in Athens, in 2010 at the Cosmopolitan Hotel in Las Vegas, 2012 in Miami Beach, Milos London in 2016, and most recently, Milos Hudson Yards and Los Cabos in 2019. Our Las Vegas restaurant moves to The Venetian in Las Vegas in March 2021. And we are excited to announce that we opened Dubai in February 2023.

About Thames & Hudson
---------------------

Thames & Hudson was founded in 1949 by Walter and Eva Neurath. Their passion and mission was to create a ‘museum without walls’ and to make accessible to a large reading public the world of art and the research of top scholars. To reflect its international outlook the name for the company linked the rivers flowing through London and New York, represented in its logo by two dolphins symbolizing friendship and intelligence, one facing east, one west, suggesting a connection between the Old World and the New.  
  
Today, still an independent, family-owned company, Thames & Hudson is one of the world’s leading publishers of illustrated books with over 2,000 titles in print. We publish high-quality books across ‎all areas of visual creativity: the arts (fine, applied, decorative, performing), architecture, design, photography, fashion, film and music, and also archaeology, history and popular culture. Our children’s books list is also expanding. Headquartered in London, we have a sister company in New York and subsidiaries in Melbourne, Singapore and Hong Kong. In Paris, a further subsidiary company, Interart, distributes English-language books in France.

About Athlete Network
---------------------

Founded by former college athletes, Athlete Network is the leader in software solutions for current and former student-athlete engagement and support. #KeepCompeting  
  
With the mission of helping athletes advance after their playing days through community, internships, and careers, Athlete Network began by partnering with companies and graduate schools to connect them more efficiently with this elite network of athletes that positively impact their goals and naturally fit into their organization's culture.  
  
Athletic departments and athletic associations are continually striving to enhance the student-athlete experience and engage with their former athletes to strengthen and build community during and beyond their competitive playing days and throughout their careers.  
  
UNITE powered by Athlete Network is branded software allowing leaders within athletic departments and athletic associations to organize, promote, and track the programs and services offered to their current and former student-athletes. By nurturing the relationship with their athletes through UNITE software, both athletic departments and athletic associations have substantially improved engagement, increased revenue and fundraising, and gained valuable data analytics and reporting.  
  
The goal of Athlete Network is simple, keep athletes competing by uniting them in a hub built by athletes for athletes through connections, resources, mentoring, and careers.

Our authors include Robert Greene, Ryan Holiday, Mary Beard, Shoshana Zuboff, Oliver Bullough and Kwame Anthony Appiah.  
  
We are the proud publishing partner of The Economist Books and the Wellcome Collection books.  
  
In January 2007 Profile acquired Serpent’s Tail, a company that publishes highly distinctive award-winning international fiction such as We Need to Talk About Kevin by Lionel Shriver, Sarah Perry's The Essex Serpent and Esi Edugyan's Washington Black as well as cutting-edge non fiction.  
  
In 2018, Profile took over Souvenir Press, which has a backlist of 500 active titles and is especially strong in psychology, personal development, health and wellness.  
  
The company has been Small Publisher of the Year on three occasions. It prides itself on its commitment to its books and its authors, its professionalism and business rigour, its open management style and its nimbleness in responding to market opportunities.

About Sociedad Argentina de Hipertensión Arterial
-------------------------------------------------

a Sociedad Argentina de Hipertensión Arterial fue fundada en el año 1992 por un grupo de pioneros y visionarios que, reconociendo a la hipertensión arterial como una afección con un necesario enfoque multidisciplinario, convocaron a colegas provenientes de distintas profesiones y especialidades para que se agruparan en una institución que fuera el marco de estos diversos intereses. Es así que en la década del noventa comienzan los preparativos para el nacimiento de la SAHA. El crecimiento de la institución, verificado en el incremento del número de socios, ha quedado plasmado, a su vez, en nuestra sede institucional en la calle Perón 1479, de la Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires. A más de 24 años de gestión, y merced al esfuerzo de numerosos miembros que han trabajado incansablemente en comisiones directivas, organización de eventos científicos, página web, o cursos, entre otras tareas, la SAHA se ha consolidado como referente nacional e internacional. Este crecimiento constante se puede objetivar en el elevado nivel científico, la numerosa concurrencia a nuestras actividades, una inagotable vocación por la capacitación de nuestros socios y de médicos jóvenes interesados en la formación en hipertensión arterial, los 22 Congresos realizados hasta la fecha, la consolidación del Curso Nacional Bianual de Hipertensión Arterial, y en los convenios de colaboración contraídos con sociedades científicas afines.

About Youth Villages
--------------------

Youth Villages is a national leader in children’s mental and behavioral health, bringing help and hope to tens of thousands of children, families and young people across the United States every year. Founded in 1986, the organization’s 3,600-plus employees help more than 36,000 children annually in 23 states and D.C. For more than 30 years, we have worked to find solutions using proven treatment models that strengthen the child’s family and support systems and dramatically improve their long-term success.  
  
Since 1994, our organization has tracked every child who completes a program and has recorded consistently high success rates. In 2018, 86% of the children are still living successfully at home with their families 12 months after completing their program.  
  
Youth Villages has been recognized by the Harvard Business School and U.S. News & World Report and was identified by The White House as one of the nation’s most promising results-oriented nonprofit organizations.

What types of services does Youth Villages provide for children and families?

Youth Villages offers a comprehensive range of services designed to support children and families facing mental and behavioral health challenges. These services include residential treatment programs, in-home services, crisis intervention, counseling, foster care support, adoption services, and transitional living programs for young adults. The organization focuses on providing individualized care to help children thrive in their home environments and communities.

How does Youth Villages support children in foster care?

Youth Villages provides specialized services for children in foster care, including therapeutic support and case management. The organization works closely with foster families to ensure that children receive the emotional and behavioral support they need. Youth Villages also offers training and resources for foster parents to help them create a nurturing environment that promotes healing and stability for the children in their care.

What is the process for accessing Youth Villages' services?

To access services from Youth Villages, families can reach out directly through the organization's website or by calling their local office. A representative will guide them through the intake process, which typically involves an assessment of the child's needs and the family's circumstances. This assessment helps determine the most appropriate services and supports to implement. Youth Villages accepts referrals from various sources, including schools, social services, and healthcare providers.

What age groups does Youth Villages serve?

Youth Villages serves a wide range of age groups, from young children to young adults up to the age of 24. The organization tailors its programs to meet the specific developmental and emotional needs of each age group, ensuring that children and young adults receive the appropriate support as they navigate challenges related to mental health, behavioral issues, and life transitions.

Does Youth Villages offer services for families in crisis?

Yes, Youth Villages provides crisis services designed to assist families in urgent need. These services include immediate intervention and support for families experiencing acute behavioral or emotional crises. The goal is to stabilize the situation and connect families with ongoing resources and support to prevent future crises. Youth Villages' crisis services are available to help families regain stability and improve their overall well-being.

How does Youth Villages measure the success of its programs?

Youth Villages employs a data-driven approach to measure the effectiveness of its programs. The organization tracks various outcomes, including improvements in mental health, behavioral stability, and family functioning. By utilizing evidence-based practices and ongoing assessments, Youth Villages continuously evaluates its services to ensure they meet the needs of children and families. Success is measured not only by clinical outcomes but also by the long-term well-being and stability of the children and families served.

Who is the CEO of Harbor Psychiatry And Mental Health?

.

Who are the decision makers in Harbor Psychiatry And Mental Health?

The decision makers in Harbor Psychiatry And Mental Health are [Al Mozayeni](https://contactout.com/al-mozayeni-74008)
, [Gisoo Zarrabi](https://contactout.com/gisoo-zarrabi-58353)

.

What types of services does Harbor Psychiatry and Mental Health offer?

Harbor Psychiatry and Mental Health provides a wide range of behavioral health services, including psychological testing, psychotherapy, medication management, and specialized psychiatry services. We also offer advanced treatments such as Transmagnetic Stimulation (TMS) and Intranasal Ketamine Treatment, as well as psychogenomic testing to tailor treatment plans based on individual genetic profiles.

How does psychological testing work at Harbor Mental Health?

Psychological testing at Harbor Mental Health involves a comprehensive assessment conducted by licensed professionals. This process includes standardized tests and interviews to evaluate cognitive, emotional, and behavioral functioning. The results help in diagnosing mental health conditions and developing effective treatment plans tailored to each individual's needs.

What is Transmagnetic Stimulation (TMS) and how can it help me?

Transmagnetic Stimulation (TMS) is a non-invasive treatment that uses magnetic fields to stimulate nerve cells in the brain. It is primarily used for treating depression, especially in patients who have not responded to traditional therapies. TMS is well-tolerated, has minimal side effects, and can lead to significant improvements in mood and overall mental health.

Can I receive medication management services at Harbor Mental Health?

Yes, Harbor Mental Health offers medication management services as part of our comprehensive behavioral health approach. Our experienced psychiatrists work closely with patients to evaluate their medication needs, monitor progress, and make necessary adjustments to optimize treatment outcomes. We prioritize patient safety and efficacy in all medication-related decisions.

What industries does Harbor Psychiatry and Mental Health support?

Harbor Psychiatry and Mental Health supports a variety of industries, including healthcare, education, corporate wellness, and community organizations. We provide tailored mental health solutions that address the unique challenges faced by these sectors, promoting overall well-being and productivity among employees, students, and community members.

How can I get started with treatment at Harbor Mental Health?

To get started with treatment at Harbor Mental Health, you can visit our website to schedule an initial consultation or call our office directly. During the first appointment, our team will conduct a thorough assessment to understand your needs and develop a personalized treatment plan. We aim to make the process as seamless and supportive as possible.

About Arcep
-----------

Envie de défendre la neutralité du net, de contribuer à l'amélioration des réseaux, d'agir pour la connectivité des territoires, de faire pivoter l'Administration... ?  
Ingénieurs, économistes, juristes ou tout simplement passionnés, rejoignez-nous !  
  
L’Autorité de régulation des communications électroniques et des postes (Arcep), arbitre expert et neutre au statut d’autorité administrative indépendante, est l’architecte et le gardien des réseaux d’échanges en France.  
  
Architecte des réseaux, l’Arcep crée les conditions d’une organisation plurielle et décentralisée des réseaux. Elle garantit l’ouverture du marché à de nouveaux acteurs et à toutes les formes d’innovation, et veille à la compétitivité du secteur à travers une concurrence favorable à l’investissement. L’Arcep organise le cadre d’interopérabilité des réseaux, afin qu’ils apparaissent comme un seul aux yeux des utilisateurs malgré leur diversité, simples d’accès et non cloisonnés. Elle coordonne la bonne articulation public/privé dans le cadre de l’intervention des collectivités territoriales.  
  
Gardien des réseaux, l’Arcep s’assure du respect des principes essentiels pour garantir la capacité d’échange des utilisateurs. Elle veille à la fourniture du service universel, et accompagne les pouvoirs publics pour étendre la connectivité sur l’ensemble du territoire. Elle assure la liberté de choix et la bonne information des utilisateurs, et protège contre les atteintes possibles à la neutralité de l’internet.  
  
L’Autorité lutte plus généralement contre toutes les formes de silos qui pourraient menacer la liberté d’échanger sur les réseaux, et s’intéresse à ce titre aux nouveaux intermédiaires que sont les grandes plateformes internet.

### Frequently Asked Questions about Arcep

What is the role of Arcep in promoting net neutrality?

Arcep, as an independent administrative authority, plays a crucial role in ensuring net neutrality in France. This means that all internet traffic is treated equally, without discrimination or charging differentially by user, content, website, platform, application, or method of communication. Arcep monitors compliance with net neutrality regulations and takes action against any violations to protect consumers and promote fair competition in the telecommunications market.

How does Arcep contribute to improving network connectivity in rural areas?

Arcep is actively involved in initiatives aimed at enhancing network connectivity in underserved and rural areas. This includes working with local authorities and telecom operators to facilitate the deployment of high-speed broadband infrastructure. By promoting policies that encourage investment in these regions, Arcep helps ensure that all citizens have access to reliable internet services, which is essential for economic development and social inclusion.

What types of professionals does Arcep seek to hire?

Arcep seeks to hire a diverse range of professionals, including engineers, economists, and legal experts, who are passionate about telecommunications and digital transformation. The organization values individuals who are committed to public service and have a strong understanding of the regulatory landscape in Europe. Candidates with experience in areas such as 5G technology, internet regulation, and digital accessibility are particularly encouraged to apply.

What initiatives does Arcep support for digital transformation in public administration?

Arcep supports various initiatives aimed at fostering digital transformation within public administration. This includes promoting the use of advanced telecommunications technologies to improve public services and enhance citizen engagement. Arcep also collaborates with government bodies to develop regulatory frameworks that facilitate innovation and ensure that public services are accessible to all, regardless of their location.

How does Arcep ensure the quality of internet services in France?

Arcep monitors the quality of internet services through regular assessments and reports on broadband performance across the country. This includes measuring factors such as speed, latency, and reliability. The authority also sets benchmarks for service providers and encourages transparency by requiring them to publish information about their service quality. By holding providers accountable, Arcep aims to ensure that consumers receive high-quality internet services.

What is Arcep's approach to regulating the postal sector?

Arcep regulates the postal sector to ensure that postal services are accessible, reliable, and affordable for all citizens. The authority oversees the universal postal service, which guarantees that everyone can send and receive mail regardless of their location. Arcep also monitors market competition and works to prevent anti-competitive practices, ensuring that consumers benefit from a variety of postal services and pricing options.

About London Diamond Bourse
---------------------------

For the best part of 70 years we have operated the foremost UK diamond trading floor.  
  
In the heart of Hatton Garden, hidden amongst the many different jewellery shops which make up London’s iconic jewellery district, in a building particularly designed for the diamond trade, lies the London Diamond Bourse (LDB). An organization steeped in history and the only diamond trading floor in the UK. An organisation with such an interesting past, and such an interesting future. You are encouraged to read our history and to understand the beginnings of what used to be a small club formed by Jewish settlers after the second World War in a little cafe. Today, the LDB has a more diverse membership and is recognised by the Foreign and Commonwealth Office as a Trade Association. We are a prominent member of the World Federation of Diamond Bourses (WFDB) and are one of only 30 active diamond trading floors in the world.  
  
To count yourself as one of the members of our organisation is an honour not given all those that apply. Membership is offered based on an individual basis and you will be subject to various checks before you are admitted to our organisation. You will also need to commit to operate under ours and the WFDB rules.  
  
Find our website at www.londondiamondbourse.com

About BESA Group
----------------

The BESA has been putting its members at the heart of building engineering services since 1904.  
  
BESA - the Building Engineering Services Association is the UK's leading trade association for building services engineering contractors – representing the interests of firms active in the design, installation, commissioning, maintenance, control and management of engineering systems and services in buildings.  
  
BESA’s headquarters are in London, but we are active throughout the UK. We have a separate presence in Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland, as well as eight regional offices across England. This regional presence facilitates member networking and sharing of best practice, business opportunities and advice on local and national developments.  
  
One of the key requirements of BESA membership is the demonstration of technical competence, commercial capability and adherence to health and safety best practice. This is assessed through regular, third-party inspection and auditing, ensuring our members are upholding what is affectionately referred to as the association’s ‘badge of quality.’  
  
BESA membership means that clients can be sure they are employing firms who work to the highest standards, giving reassurance that their project is in safe hands.  
  
BESA members benefit from access to a wide range of services and support that is carefully tailored to their needs, and which helps them to build better and more profitable businesses. BESA is committed to lobbying on behalf of its members on a wide range of issues that affect their businesses and the commercial environment in which they operate.  
  
BESA is itself a member of the Specialist Engineering Contractors' (SEC) Group and of the Air Conditioning and Refrigeration Industry Board (ACRIB) and works closely with other bodies throughout the sector – including BSRIA, CIBSE, ECA and FETA and is a member of the CIBSE Patrons corporate supporters’ network.
