About Puerto Rico Aqueduct & Sewer Authority
--------------------------------------------

The Puerto Rico Aqueduct and Sewer Authority (“the Authority”) is a public corporation and governmental instrumentality of the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico. The Authority owns and operates the public water supply and wastewater systems (“the Systems”) of the Commonwealth, making the Authority the sole provider of these services throughout Puerto Rico.  
  
The Authority’s core mission is to provide quality water and sewer service at the lowest possible cost to its customers. To achieve this mission, PRASA envisions that it must strive to be a World-Class Utility. Therefore, the Authority is committed to provide an efficient, safe, reliable and high-quality service to its customers to protect public health, safeguard environmental quality, and promote social sustainability.  
  
The Authority serves a population of approximately 3.5 million residents plus approximately 4 million visitors annually. The Authority is the sole provider of water and wastewater services in Puerto Rico, providing about 98% and 59% of Puerto Rico’s population, respectively. While this is positive in terms of sales of services, it also makes the Authority a critical entity for the wellbeing of Puerto Rico. The effective operation of this vital public service is essential to the health and economic prosperity of Puerto Rico and its citizens.  
  
The Authority serves 1.3 million customers and the System consisting of 116 water filtration plants, 51 wastewater treatment plants, 1,723 pump stations, 2,186 tanks, 299 water supply wells, over 20,000 miles of pipelines, and 6 ocean outfalls.  
  
Because Puerto Rico is an island with varied topography, isolated demographic distributions, and a diverse mix of users; the Authority has a mostly fragmented and localized system of water sources, treatment and delivery systems. As a result, the Authority has many more treatment facilities than most utilities serving a similar number of customers.

About University of Alaska
--------------------------

The university system started as the Alaska Agricultural College and School of Mines in Fairbanks, later renamed the University of Alaska. That first year, the campus was a single two-story frame building and had just six students. The school was renamed the University of Alaska in 1935.  
  
In 1954, Anchorage Community College (now known as the University of Alaska Anchorage) was incorporated into the University of Alaska. That next year, Juneau Community College was established and was later named the University of Alaska Southeast.  
  
The UA system’s largest hubs (UAA, UAF and UAS) are separately accredited institutions, as is Prince William Sound Community College in Valdez. System-wide, nearly 33,000 full- and part-time students are enrolled, studying among 500 unique degree, certificate or endorsement programs. Study areas include short-course workforce training, associate degrees, bachelor’s and master’s degrees, as well as doctorates. Programs include a wide array of the sciences, engineering, teacher and early childhood education, business, journalism and communications, aviation, health occupations, history, English, the arts and humanities and many others.  
  
Per the Alaska Constitution, an 11-member board of regents governs the system. The system president serves as the board’s chief executive officer. Chancellors for each of the hubs—UAA, UAF and UAS--report to the president.

About American Leather
----------------------

In 1990, American Leather was founded on the revolutionary idea that custom leather furniture could be made and shipped in three weeks or less. In the years since, American Leather has evolved from setting a precedent with quick-ship delivery to setting the standards by which all other custom furniture manufacturers are measured.  
  
What began as a small team in a borrowed facility has grown to more than 600 employees in Dallas, Texas, housed in a state-of-the art 350,000-square-foot factory.  
  
While impressive in size, our true growth is measured by our innovation, technological advances and performance. By the dynamic collections we introduce each year. By our commitment to, and the loyalty of, our retail customers. As well as by the countless furniture lovers who have become our biggest fans. And finally, by our resolve to do the right thing: maintain U.S. manufacturing jobs, meet retail partner and consumer needs, and enhance the quality of life of our employees – even as the industry continues to turn to offshore manufacturing.  
  
We remain firmly rooted in our heritage of speed, quality, and customization, and we especially value the entrepreneurial mindset that always asks: “Why not?” We believe it’s this approach to innovation that makes us stand apart – whether applied in our factory, a sofa design, an engineering advancement, or a brainstorming meeting.  
  
We look forward to all the future holds, while acknowledging the solid foundation for success that our history provides. And we look forward to continuing the journey with you, our valued partners, and gratefully acknowledge your role in our success – yesterday, today, and tomorrow.

Jessica Mendoza is a trailblazer, transforming the way female athletes are perceived in the media and inspiring millions through her exceptional commentary. About Anne Bradstreet

Anne Bradstreet, often referred to as the "first American poet," was a pioneering figure in the world of literature. Born in Northampton, England in 1612, Bradstreet came to America with her family in 1630, seeking religious freedom in the New World. Settling in the Massachusetts Bay Colony, Bradstreet's writing was heavily influenced by her Puritan upbringing and the challenges of her new life in America.  
  
Bradstreet's poetry is known for its exploration of themes such as love, faith, and the passage of time. Her work reflects the struggles and triumphs of the early American settlers, offering a unique glimpse into the daily life of the colonial period. Bradstreet's writing also reveals her deep devotion to her faith and her ongoing struggle to reconcile her conflicting roles as a woman, a mother, and a poet in a male-dominated society.  
  
One of Bradstreet's most well-known works is "The Tenth Muse Lately Sprung Up in America," a collection of her poetry that was published in 1650. This collection made history as the first book of poetry to be published by a woman in America. Bradstreet's poems are deeply personal, often reflecting on her own experiences as a wife, mother, and religious believer. Her poem "To My Dear and Loving Husband" is a particularly moving example of her emotional and introspective style, expressing her deep love and admiration for her husband, Simon Bradstreet.  
  
In addition to her personal and introspective poetry, Bradstreet also wrote about historical and political events of her time. Her poem "In Memory of My Dear Grandchild Elizabeth Bradstreet, Who Deceased August, 1665, Being a Year and a Half Old" mourns the loss of her granddaughter and reflects on the uncertainty and fragility of life. This poem is a powerful example of Bradstreet's ability to convey complex emotions with simplicity and grace.  
  
Despite the challenges and limitations she faced as a woman in the 17th century, Bradstreet's poetry received significant recognition during her lifetime. Her work was well-regarded by her contemporaries, earning her the title of "The Tenth Muse" and cementing her place as an influential literary figure. Bradstreet's writing continues to be celebrated today for its lyrical beauty, timeless themes, and groundbreaking significance in the history of American literature.  
  
In conclusion, Anne Bradstreet's impact on the world of poetry cannot be overstated. About Tuskegee University
-------------------------

From Tuskegee University’s proud past comes a greatness that — more than 138 years later — still permeates the hallowed grounds of the historic campus. It is where founder Booker T. Washington maintained that students must learn a trade and not just a degree, and that educating the heart was as important as training the head and the hands. It is where George Washington Carver revolutionized agricultural research and outreach. And, where the Tuskegee Airmen soared into history during World War II through their valor and patriotism.  
  
Today, as a private, state-related institution and one of Alabama’s three land-grant universities, Tuskegee continues to be regarded internationally for its academic and research innovation that uniquely combines the humanities, professional and STEM disciplines. Its rigorous academic programs lead to 41 undergraduate, 16 master’s and five doctoral degree programs. The university hosts one of Alabama’s two schools of veterinary medicine — and the only one in the country located at an HBCU. Likewise, Tuskegee is home to the nation’s only HBCU-based accredited aerospace engineering program.  
  
In September 2019, U.S. News and World Report ranked Tuskegee 8th nationally among the country’s historically black colleges and universities (HBCUs) and 25th among southern regional universities. It is consistently cited by Diverse: Issues in Higher Education as one of the nation’s top producers of minority graduates in agricultural and natural resource disciplines, architecture, biological and biomedical sciences, engineering, physical sciences, rehabilitation and therapeutic professions, and veterinary medicine — just to name a few.  
  
Its nearly 3,000 students represent nearly every U.S. state and a dozen countries. Its student population, more than 600 employees and property holdings spanning 5,500-plus acres make it a major contributor to Macon County’s residential, employment  
  
For more information about Tuskegee University, visit www.tuskegee.edu.

Who are the decision makers in CAV Angels?

The decision makers in CAV Angels are [Elizabeth Blankenship](https://contactout.com/elizabeth-blankenship-64958)

.

What types of startups does CAV Angels support?

CAV Angels primarily supports high-potential startups that have a strong connection to the University of Virginia (UVA). This includes businesses founded by UVA alumni or those that have been significantly influenced by the UVA community. We focus on a variety of industries, including technology, healthcare, consumer products, and more, as long as the startups demonstrate innovation and growth potential.

How can startups apply for funding through CAV Angels?

Startups interested in securing funding through CAV Angels can apply by submitting their business plan and pitch deck through our online application portal. We recommend including detailed information about your business model, market analysis, team background, and financial projections. Once submitted, our team will review the application and may reach out for further discussions or to schedule a pitch presentation.

What is the process for becoming an angel investor with CAV Angels?

To become an angel investor with CAV Angels, individuals must have a connection to the University of Virginia, either as alumni, faculty, or through other affiliations. Interested investors can fill out our investor application form on our website. After a review process, we will invite qualified individuals to join our network, where they can access investment opportunities and participate in mentorship programs.

What kind of mentorship does CAV Angels provide to startups?

CAV Angels offers tailored mentorship to startups through our network of experienced investors and industry professionals. This mentorship can include guidance on business strategy, marketing, fundraising, and operational challenges. We aim to connect startups with mentors who have relevant expertise and can provide valuable insights to help them navigate their growth journey.

Are there any fees associated with applying for funding or mentorship through CAV Angels?

CAV Angels does not charge startups any fees to apply for funding or mentorship. Our goal is to support the growth of UVA-connected startups without imposing financial barriers. However, if a startup successfully secures funding, standard investment terms and conditions will apply, which may include equity stakes or other arrangements agreed upon during the investment process.

How does CAV Angels ensure a good fit between investors and startups?

CAV Angels takes great care in matching investors with startups by considering various factors such as industry expertise, investment preferences, and the specific needs of the startup. We conduct thorough assessments and discussions with both parties to ensure alignment in goals and expectations. This personalized approach helps foster successful partnerships and increases the likelihood of startup success.

About Aveanna  
It all started with a simple idea: How can we help people live better lives by providing better homecare? That idea became a company called Aveanna, dedicated to bringing new possibilities and new hope to those we serve.  
  
At Aveanna, we believe that the ultimate place for caring is right in the comfort of home. We are a new company that has quickly established itself as a pre-eminent, national leader in healthcare as well as homecare. We believe in clinical excellence, innovation, and compassionate care to every patient and family we are privileged to help. But what sets us apart most is our focus on the relationship between the caregiver and the patient. By surrounding our patients with superior resources, and by giving our caregivers better technology and training, we are able to provide superior care that makes a difference in what’s possible in outcomes and daily living.  
  
Aveanna’s leadership team has worked for more than 40 years building other great homecare companies on a national level. Now that experience is building the homecare company of the future. We are a family held company, employing over 600 associates and operating out of six manufacturing buildings in Hickory, North Carolina, and a 40,000-square foot showroom in High Point, NC and our newest manufacturing location in Hillsville, Virginia.  
  
Our mission is to lead home furnishings in style, value, and service with a vision to enrich lives through custom-crafted furniture. What types of services does ITG offer to brokers and asset managers?

ITG provides a comprehensive suite of services designed to enhance trading efficiency and improve returns for investors. Our offerings include algorithmic trading solutions, crossing networks, dark pool access, electronic trading tools, and strategy consulting. We also specialize in global FIX connectivity, liquidity management, market structure insights, trading analytics, transaction cost analysis, and workflow technology.

How does ITG's algorithmic trading technology benefit traders?

ITG's algorithmic trading technology is designed to optimize trading strategies by leveraging advanced algorithms that analyze market conditions in real-time. This allows traders to execute orders more efficiently, minimize market impact, and reduce transaction costs. Our algorithms are customizable, enabling traders to tailor their strategies to meet specific investment goals and market conditions.

What are dark pools, and how does ITG facilitate access to them?

Dark pools are private trading venues that allow institutional investors to trade large blocks of shares without revealing their intentions to the public market. ITG facilitates access to these dark pools through its advanced trading platforms, providing clients with the tools they need to execute trades discreetly while maintaining competitive pricing and minimizing market impact.

Can ITG help with transaction cost analysis, and what does that entail?

Yes, ITG offers transaction cost analysis (TCA) services that help clients evaluate the effectiveness of their trading strategies. Our TCA tools analyze various factors, such as execution quality, market conditions, and trading costs, to provide insights into the performance of trades. This analysis enables clients to identify areas for improvement, optimize their trading strategies, and ultimately enhance their investment returns.

What industries does ITG serve, and how do its solutions cater to their specific needs?

ITG serves a diverse range of industries, including asset management, hedge funds, and brokerage firms. Our solutions are tailored to meet the unique challenges faced by these sectors, such as the need for efficient trade execution, access to liquidity, and comprehensive market insights. By offering specialized tools and consulting services, ITG helps clients navigate the complexities of the financial markets and achieve their investment objectives.

How does ITG ensure the security and reliability of its trading platforms?

ITG prioritizes the security and reliability of its trading platforms through robust technology infrastructure and stringent security protocols. We employ advanced encryption methods, regular security audits, and continuous monitoring to protect client data and ensure the integrity of our systems. Additionally, our platforms are designed for high availability and resilience, minimizing downtime and ensuring that clients can execute trades seamlessly.

About Ehrenkrantz Eckstut & Kuhn Architects
-------------------------------------------

EE&K a Perkins Eastman company is an architecture firm internationally recognized for integrating the design of buildings and open spaces to turn projects into places. Founded in 1959, EE&K’s record of bringing creative thinking and big picture perspective to design problems of all scales has created buildings of enduring memory, economic resilience and lasting value. Our design philosophy is based on the concept that when buildings are designed together with the larger environment, the whole can be greater than the sum of the parts. EE&K merged its practice with Perkins Eastman in 2011, creating enhanced capabilities, expanded global reach, and client value.  
  
Both firms believe that the design of the built environment is critical to the quality of life and that skilled architects play a critical role. Both have a portfolio of large-scale developments that share a set of common values: the objective of creating new urban places that foster vibrant public communities. Projects are designed to become authentic parts of the larger whole of their encompassing communities–aesthetically, culturally, and historically–true places that enrich the urban fabric.  
  
Together, the firm’s expertise encompasses everything from large–scale urban redevelopment to signature campus buildings; urban waterfronts to transportation hubs; primary schools to complex mixed-use development; and major hospitals to destination hotels.

===============

About Ignite! Reading
---------------------

When kids learn to read on time their opportunities in school and life improve profoundly. If a child cannot read by the time they are in third grade, they are four times less likely to graduate high school.\* In 2022, only 33% of U.S. fourth graders and 31% of eighth graders were reading at grade level (National Assessment of Educational Progress reading assessment scores). Ignite! Reading is on a mission to fix this.  
  
Ignite partners with schools and districts nationally to provide K-8 students reading instruction grounded in the Science of Reading. Schools in the Ignite program receive a dedicated team of virtual tutors who are highly trained in an evidence-based foundational reading skills curriculum rooted in the Science of Reading. Tutors meet virtually each day with students in targeted 1:1, 15-minute sessions. Baseline assessments and data from routine progress monitoring give tutors insight into decoding gaps, allowing them to tailor lessons to each student’s specific needs as a developing reader. Tutoring happens during the school day and can seamlessly fit into a school’s literacy block.  
  
Ignite’s results speak for themselves. During the 2021-2022 school year, students in the Ignite program made 2.4 weeks of reading progress for every week in the program. Those same results held true for students of color, white students, multilingual learners, students with IEPs, and those receiving free and reduced lunch.  
  
“I haven’t seen anything as simple or effective in a while. It’s such an innovative, promising approach to closing the achievement gap. I’m really excited about it.” - Assistant Superintendent, Worcester, MA  
  
\*Double Jeopardy: How Third-Grade Reading Skills and Poverty Influence High School Graduation

About Holtec International
--------------------------

Holtec International is a global turnkey supplier of equipment and services for the Nuclear, Solar, Geothermal, and Fossil Power Generation sectors of the energy and petrochemical industry. As a fully integrated supplier, Holtec possesses in-house capabilities to design, engineer, analyze, construct, license, and deploy the technologies offered by the company; this includes technologies to manage used nuclear fuel and waste discharged from nuclear reactors and wet and dry (air cooled) heat transfer equipment for commercial power plants. Holtec is also developing a Small Modular Reactor (SMR), which will provide for modular, distributed, carbon-free, base-load energy.  
  
Holtec International’s industrial activities are principally focused on six continents: North America, South America, Europe, Asia, Africa and Australia. Britain, Spain, Switzerland, Belgium, China, Ukraine, Canada, Mexico, the United States and Brazil are among the countries where Holtec International has provided significant goods and services. The domestic market in the United States, however, has been the catalyst for Holtec’s technical innovations in its fields of endeavor, which the company has successfully parlayed into business successes in overseas markets. Over 70% of Holtec’s output is consumed by the domestic power industry; the balance is destined for foreign markets. What services does Holtec International offer for nuclear power plants?

Holtec International offers a wide range of services for nuclear power plants, including the design and manufacturing of Dry Spent Fuel Storage and Transport Equipment, Wet Spent Fuel Storage Equipment, and Small Modular Reactors (SMRs). We focus on optimizing performance, reliability, and cost-effectiveness in our designs.

Does Holtec International provide solutions for spent fuel management?

Yes, Holtec International specializes in spent fuel management solutions. About Travco Corporation Ltd.
-----------------------------

Travco is a leading global hotel wholesaler. Our core business focus is supplying hotel accommodation to the travel trade. By cooperating with thousands of international hotels we are able to offer an outstanding selection of global hotel accommodation at the lowest rates.  
  
Our clients can book hotels in 5 seconds through our advanced online booking system or sell our entire product range through their own branded website via our XML interface. The booking systems can be viewed in 9 major languages and our hotel guides are also being translated, providing multilingual options for our global client base. In order to guarantee satisfaction with our products we also provide a range of additional services, including 24/7 FIT support and dedicated technical and customer service.  
  
Travco is a family run and owned business, founded in 1988. By constantly adapting to your growing needs we have rapidly developed into a trusted industry leader. Despite our impressive accomplishments we remain true to our roots, offering all of our clients an unmatched personal level of service. At our London head office and various local branch offices we have an experienced team of employees who ensure all your requests are swiftly met.  
  
With thousands of global clients continually profiting from Travco's business, our reputation for delivering success is well established.  
  
In 2018 Travco celebrated its 30th anniversary, proudly marking 30 years of dedicated service to the travel industry!

About Tabriz University Of Medical Sciences
-------------------------------------------

Tabriz University of Medical Sciences (TBZMED) is public medical sciences university located in Tabriz, East Azarbaijan Province, Iran. It is ranked as one of Iran's top medical schools, with more than 5000 students.  
The University consists of seven faculties: Medicine, Pharmacy, Dentistry, Paramedical Sciences, Health & Nutrition, Rehabilitation, and Nursing & Midwifery. The school offers professional degrees in Medicine (M.D.), Dentistry (D.D.S.), Pharmacy (Pharm.D.); Bachelor's, Master's, and Doctor of Philosophy(Ph.D.) in various other medically related subjects. The school also offers technical courses in pursuit of Associate's degrees and certification in medically related fields.  
In addition, TUMS operates over 10 teaching hospitals and is a major medical care provider in East Azarbaijan Province and the surrounding provinces.  
  
Source: http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tabriz\_University\_of\_Medical\_Sciences

About Richard Dawkins

Richard Dawkins is a British evolutionary biologist and author who has contributed immensely to popularizing science and rational thinking. Known for his iconic work "The Selfish Gene," Dawkins has become a prominent figure in the field of evolutionary biology, shedding light on complex concepts with his eloquent and engaging writing style.  
  
Born on March 26, 1941, in Nairobi, Kenya, Dawkins spent his early years in Africa, igniting his curiosity about the natural world. He later moved to England and attended Oxford University, where he obtained a bachelor's degree in zoology and later a doctorate in evolutionary biology. His academic journey laid the foundation for his lifelong passion for understanding the mechanisms behind evolution and how it shapes all living organisms.  
  
Dawkins' breakthrough came in 1976 with the publication of "The Selfish Gene," a book that presented a new perspective on the nature of genes and their role in evolution. In this revolutionary work, he argued that it is not the individual organism but rather its genes that drive evolutionary processes. Dawkins coined the term "meme" to describe an idea or behavior that spreads through cultural transmission, thus introducing the concept of cultural evolution.  
  
"The Selfish Gene" instantly became a classic, captivating readers with its clear explanations and thought-provoking ideas. Dawkins skillfully intertwines scientific knowledge with philosophical musings, prompting readers to question their understanding of life and the nature of existence. He challenges traditional notions of altruism and emphasizes the significance of gene replication as the ultimate goal of evolution. This perspective sparked intense debate, promoting a new era of evolutionary biology and inspiring countless scientists to delve deeper into the field.  
  
Following the success of his first book, Dawkins continued to produce influential works that captured the imagination of both the scientific community and the general public. One such book, "The Blind Watchmaker" (1986), delves into the intricacies of natural selection, eloquently debunking the notion of a divine designer. Drawing upon examples from the natural world, Dawkins showcases the remarkable complexity that can arise through gradual changes and the cumulative effects of natural selection.  
  
Dawkins is known for his unwavering dedication to promoting scientific literacy and reason. His works frequently challenge religious beliefs and superstitions, advocating for a world based on evidence and logical reasoning rather than dogma. In his 2006 bestseller, "The God Delusion," Dawkins explores the irrationality of faith and underscores the importance of critical thinking. His lucid arguments against religion have made him a spokesperson for atheism and a leader in the New Atheist movement.  
  
Beyond his books, Dawkins has engaged in various media formats to disseminate scientific knowledge and promote rational thinking. He has appeared on numerous television programs and documentaries, captivating audiences with his charisma and depth of knowledge. Dawkins' ability to communicate complex scientific ideas in a relatable manner has made him a highly sought-after public speaker, fostering a love for science among people from all walks of life.  
  
Despite receiving his share of controversy, Dawkins continues to be an influential figure in the scientific community. He has been recognized with numerous awards and honors for his contributions to evolutionary biology and the public understanding of science. Furthermore, his impact extends beyond academia, as his books have sold millions of copies worldwide, inspiring individuals to approach the world with curiosity, reason, and a hunger for knowledge.  
  
In summary, Richard Dawkins is a brilliant British evolutionary biologist and author who has revolutionized the way we understand evolution. Through his seminal works like "The Selfish Gene" and "The Blind Watchmaker," Dawkins has captivated audiences with his elegant writing, engaging storytelling, and ability to distill complex scientific concepts for the general public. His commitment to promoting rational thinking and scientific literacy has made him a revered figure in the realm of science communication. Richard Dawkins' legacy will endure as he continues to inspire countless individuals to explore the wonders of the natural world and question the fundamentals of life itself.

About Storm Harbor Equestrian Center
------------------------------------

At Storm Harbor, we serve the entire community, encompassing more than six counties in the Pittsburgh area. Storm Harbor Equestrian Center provides weekly Equine Assisted Activities (EAA) for people of all ages with cognitive, physical, emotional and social disabilities. The SRU Foundation Inc. is the fiscal agent for the Storm Harbor Equestrian Center.  
  
While our main focus is children and adults with disabilities, we also offer a few programs which are open to the general public. We provide certified instructors and services for our Special Olympic Equestrian Team, Disabled Veterans programs, community summer camps, many programs for individuals on the Autism Spectrum. We also offer additional day programs for local community agencies, schools and youth programs for children and adults with disabilities.  
  
OUR FACILITY  
Our Barn consists of 12 standard sized horse stalls, feed/tack room, wash bay and a separate hay shed. We have a fenced outdoor riding arena (120'-220') and a heated indoor riding arena (80'x130') with accessible wheelchair lift. Behind the barn you will find 13 acres of pasture and trails and a newly developed sensory trail.  
  
EAA ACCREDITATION  
Storm Harbor Equestrian Center is a Premier Accredited Center with PATH International (Professional Association of Therapeutic Horsemanship), a major organization in the country for equine assisted activities. All of our instructors are certified through PATH Intl. We are currently the only center with a Premier status in western Pennsylvania.

About Berkeley Lights, Inc.
---------------------------

Berkeley Lights is a leading functional cell biology company focused on enabling and accelerating the rapid development and commercialization of bio-therapeutics and other cell-based products for our customers. The Berkeley Lights Platform captures deep phenotypic, functional and genotypic information for thousands of single cells in parallel and can also deliver the live biology customers desire in the form of the best cells. Our platform is a fully integrated, end-to-end solution, comprising proprietary consumables, including our OptoSelect™ chips and reagent kits, advanced automation systems, and application software. We developed the Berkeley Lights Platform to provide the most advanced environment for rapid functional characterization of single cells at scale, the goal of which is to establish an industry standard for our customers throughout their cell-based product value chain.  
  
Berkeley Lights’ Beacon® and Lightning™ systems and Culture Station™ instrument are for research use only. Not for use in diagnostic procedures.

About ERA Architects Inc.
-------------------------

In practice since 1990, ERA Architects Inc. has over 85 staff members based in Toronto, Montréal, and Ottawa. The founding principals of ERA are members of the Ontario Association of Architects and the Canadian Association of Heritage Professionals (CAHP), and are Fellows of the Royal Architectural Institute of Canada.  
  
Architecture  
Recent and ongoing architectural projects in building conservation and adaptive reuse include Toronto’s Distillery District; Maple Leaf Gardens; Renaissance ROM; Transformation AGO; the Evergreen Brick Works; Union Station; the Artscape Wychwood Barns; Bridgepoint Health (the former Don Jail); Massey Tower; La Cour d’appel du Québec; and the Government Conference Centre.  
  
Planning  
Within our planning expertise we have a particular interest in regional and neighbourhood cultural planning; in cultural landscapes and their regeneration; and in facilitating community consultation of all stakeholders, as the democratic basis of good planning. Significant planning work includes the Tower Neighbourhood Renewal Project in Toronto; Union Station Heritage Precinct, Toronto Cultural Institutions Public Realm Study, the Culture of Outports program; and numerous Heritage Conservation District Plans and other studies in in Toronto, Hamilton, Peterborough, Kingston, Picton, and other parts of Ontario.  
  
Values  
Our core interest is in connecting heritage to wider considerations of urban design and city building, and to a larger set of cultural values that provide perspective to our work at every scale. Our core values are in generating professional integrity and expertise through research, education and mentoring. To that end ERA frequently works collaboratively with other firms to engage in city building, conserving heritage architecture and improving the built environment. We also generate publications and exhibitions related to Toronto and to Canada’s built environment.

About FOERSTER Instruments Inc.
-------------------------------

FOERSTER Instruments Inc., headquartered in Pittsburgh, PA, is a premier manufacturer and supplier of nondestructive testing (NDT) equipment, renowned for its innovative applications of nondestructive electromagnetic and eddy current testing principles. With a diverse product range that includes everything from handheld instruments to sophisticated integrated test systems, FOERSTER caters to the metals manufacturing industry, providing essential tools for crack detection, hardness measurement, magnetic property determination, electrical conductivity measurement, and heat treatment verification.  
  
In addition to its core NDT offerings, FOERSTER's Detection and Magnetics Division specializes in detecting unexploded ordnance (UXO) and landmines, employing advanced technologies for geophysical exploration and the identification of magnetic anomalies in metal products. The company also excels in integrating material handling systems with NDT equipment, addressing complex testing applications across various manufacturing sectors, including bar, tube, wire, and components.  
  
Recently, FOERSTER has launched a series of cost-effective material handling and testing systems tailored for the automotive industry, facilitating the inspection of critical components such as gears, strut rods, and bearings. Additionally, their portable Drill Collar Inspection System is designed to detect magnetic anomalies in drill collars, adhering to API Spec 7 standards. With a commitment to engineering excellence, design innovation, and comprehensive support services, FOERSTER Instruments Inc. is dedicated to providing effective solutions tailored to meet the unique needs of its clients. For inquiries and customized solutions, visit www.foerstergroup.com or call 1-800-635-0613.

How can FOERSTER's equipment assist in mine detection and verification of magnetic anomalies?

FOERSTER specializes in equipment designed for mine detection and the verification of magnetic anomalies. About Hendrickson

Magnus Hendrickson started manufacturing commercial trucks in 1913 to meet the demand for robust, durable vehicles. The company introduced the first tandem suspension in 1926.  
  
From the beginning, Hendrickson's only business has been to serve the needs of the commercial vehicle industry. This focus, bolstered by an unrelenting pursuit of technological leadership, is the key to our status as the world leader in the design and manufacture of high-quality truck, tractor, and trailer suspensions, liftable suspensions, steel leaf springs, bumpers, and stamped components for the heavy-duty transportation market.  
  
Since its acquisition by The Boler Company in 1978, Hendrickson has grown five-fold. Today, Hendrickson is a major supplier to every North American heavy-duty truck and trailer OEM, as well as many manufacturers in Europe, Australia, Mexico, Japan, and Latin America. Our products are helping these partners increase durability, lower operating costs, enhance driver comfort, and reduce weight. And after producing more than 2,000,000 walking beam truck suspensions and 2,000,000 air-ride trailer suspensions, our goal continues to be providing the most technologically advanced and differentiated products available—today and for the road ahead.

About LDA Design
----------------

The origin of the word landscape is to create a place where people belong. So at LDA Design, we follow the principles of ‘first life, then spaces, then buildings’. Whether we are designing a garden village, a rail station or a new district, we start with what people want and need.  
  
We see a growing appetite for landscape-led design because of its capacity to deliver the most vibrant places. As masterplanners of the Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park, we understand what good looks like. We have recently worked on Westminster’s largest regeneration project, Church Street. Our masterplan for Swansea Bay Tidal Lagoon combines visionary placemaking with the latest in renewable energy. We are designing the new public realm at Battersea Power Station and helping to create the first of the Eden Project’s visitor centres in China.  
  
Our 170-strong team of urban designers, landscape architects, and town and environmental planners work with developers, landowners, communities, universities and local authorities seeking our help with transformation. We are experienced in securing planning for new settlements and work across a range of infrastructure and energy projects.  
  
At LDA Design, we make great places and shape the world for the better.

About Eye Site of Tampa Bay

Founded in 1971 by Jerald B. Turner, MD, Eye Site is a full service practice staffed by five physicians, including fellowship-trained ophthalmologists, optometrists, licensed opticians, and caring staff members. Eye Site is proud to offer complete comprehensive services including sub-specialty, fellowship-trained care in glaucoma, cornea, and medical retina.  
  
Our two offices provide state-of-the-art refractive cataract surgery, as well as treatment of ocular disease, preventative care, and the latest trends in glasses and contact lenses.  
  
Thanks to the dedication of our doctors and caring staff members, we enjoy a reputation in the Tampa Bay community for quality, compassion, and state-of-the-art care. We value the trust we have earned from our patients and the many medical providers with whom we coordinate patient care.  
  
Rooted in our rich history, Eye Site has developed six core values that we strive to implement into every encounter with our patients and staff. These values include: Excellence, Customer Service, Productivity, Change and Flexibility, Honesty and Trust, and Fiscal Integrity. Each of these values plays a vital role in the way we serve our patients on a daily basis.  
  
Dr. Turner established a pervasive philosophy of patient centered care in his practice. He firmly believed that a practice that took care of its patients would have nothing to worry about for its future. Eye Site is committed to honoring Dr. Turner’s traditions of excellence by seeking to meet and exceed all of our patient’s needs and expectations.

About Natco Credit Union
------------------------

Natco Credit Union is a member-owned financial institution. Natco operates as a not-for-profit organization, with the interests of our members in mind. That makes us significantly different from banks, which are driven to operate at a profit to their stakeholders. We were established in 1944 and have provided a variety of accounts and services since then. We offer savings and checking accounts, loans, and much more. We currently have three offices – two in Richmond and one in Connersville.  
  
Natco Credit Union holds a community charter which mean anyone who lives or works in one of the following Indiana counties, you can become a member – Wayne, Fayette, Randolph, Henry, Rush, Union and Franklin. Industrial workers within a 25-mile radius of Richmond, Indiana and family members of existing Natco members are also eligible to join.  
  
Our mission is – Helping People Live Better Lives. Natco Credit Union and our staff are committed to providing members with the Right Support at the Right Time so they can enjoy Real Freedom.

About Rawlings Sporting Goods
-----------------------------

Rawlings Sporting Goods Company, Inc. is a leading manufacturer and marketer of sporting goods in the United States. Since the company’s inception in 1887, Rawlings’ mission has always centered on enabling participation by developing and producing innovative, high-performance equipment and protective apparel for the professional, amateur and entry-level player.  
  
By continuously developing technologically-enhanced products, Rawlings dominates the industry with innovative new products, enabling serious athletes to reach their full potential and achieve peak performance. With revolutionary industry and product innovations such as football shoulder pads (in 1901), lightweight protective apparel, and the S100 batting helmet line, Rawlings is the authentic and global authority on protecting athletes’ bodies from head-to-toe.  
  
Rawlings’ advisory players – from yesterday’s heroes such as Roberto Clemente, Mickey Mantle, Stan Musial and Sadaharu Oh to today’s stars of Bryce Harper, Giancarlo Stanton, Yadier Molina and Kris Bryant – embody these five core values through their play and dominance in all aspects of the game and their character and integrity off-the-field as well.  
  
With an assortment of baseball, basketball and football game-related product lines, Rawlings is present everywhere team sports are played. Leagues and conferences of all skill levels integrate Rawlings’ unparalleled product portfolio into their sports: as the Official Baseball Supplier and Official Helmet of Major League Baseball®, the official baseball of Minor League Baseball, the official baseball and softball for the NCAA®, and the approved baseball, basketball, football and softball of the National High School Federation®.  
  
Through its products, players and partnerships, Rawlings is unquestionably The Mark of a Pro™.

In 1992 Missouri approved a constitutional amendment providing term limits (previously there were no limits). No Representative may serve more than eight years in the House. About Alfa Insurance

With more than 1 million policies in force, Alfa Insurance® stands as a pillar of unwavering strength and unparalleled service to our policyholders. Alfa® continues to strive every day to be the best insurance company for its customers. As a company that truly cares, Alfa wants to be known for providing the best personalized service, making it easy for customers to do business and being there when they need insurance coverage most.  
  
Alfa's History  
As an outgrowth of the Alabama Farmers Federation, Alfa Insurance Companies began in 1946 to provide quality fire insurance to federation members, who were primarily farmers. John Tucker Harris, a prominent Lee County farmer and past president of the Lee County farm organization, sent in the first pre-insurance application. Since then, Alfa has grown to offer an excellent array of insurance coverages-including life, property and automobile -to its clients and has also become known for superior customer service. Alfa and its affiliates now provide insurance and other financial services to more than 1 million customers in multiple states.

About Robert Plant

Robert Plant is a legendary English singer-songwriter whose powerful vocals and charismatic stage presence have made him one of the most iconic figures in rock music history. Born on August 20, 1948, in West Bromwich, Staffordshire, Plant rose to fame as the lead vocalist of Led Zeppelin, an internationally acclaimed rock band that dominated the charts in the 1970s.  
  
With his distinctive wailing voice and dynamic range, Plant captivated audiences around the world. His stage presence was magnetic, often electrifying crowds with his energetic performances and captivating charisma. Plant's raw vocal delivery perfectly complemented the hard-hitting, blues-infused rock sound of Led Zeppelin, contributing to the band's immense success and everlasting influence on the genre.  
  
Before finding global fame, Plant's passion for music was cultivated from a young age. Inspired by artists like Elvis Presley, Little Richard, and Robert Johnson, he began singing in local bands while still in his teens. Plant's love for the blues and folk music grew as he immersed himself in the British music scene of the 1960s, drawing inspiration from artists like Willie Dixon, Muddy Waters, and Howlin' Wolf.  
  
In 1968, Plant joined forces with guitarist Jimmy Page, bassist John Paul Jones, and drummer John Bonham to form the rock band Led Zeppelin. The band quickly gained recognition for their innovative sound, blending elements of blues, rock, and folk into a unique and powerful musical experience. Plant's vocals were a vital ingredient in the band's success, providing an unprecedented range and intensity that set them apart from their contemporaries.  
  
Led Zeppelin's self-titled debut album, released in 1969, showcased Plant's remarkable vocal abilities on tracks like "Good Times Bad Times" and "Dazed and Confused." As the band's popularity grew, so did Plant's reputation as one of rock music's most dynamic frontmen. His onstage presence, characterized by his charismatic demeanor and long blond hair, became an iconic symbol of the band and the era.  
  
Beyond his work with Led Zeppelin, Plant embarked on a solo career that showcased his versatility as an artist. He embraced various musical genres, including folk, rock, and blues, constantly exploring new sounds and pushing boundaries. Plant's solo albums, such as "Pictures at Eleven" (1982), "Now and Zen" (1988), and "Raising Sand" (2007), displayed his growth as a songwriter and his ability to experiment with different musical styles.  
  
Plant's collaboration with Alison Krauss on the critically acclaimed album "Raising Sand" was a testament to his willingness to explore beyond his comfort zone. The album, which drew inspiration from traditional folk and country music, earned them multiple Grammy Awards, including Album of the Year. Plant's ability to adapt and reinvent himself as an artist showcased his enduring creativity and passion for music.  
  
Throughout his career, Plant has continued to captivate audiences with his indistinguishable voice and stage presence. Whether performing solo or with Led Zeppelin bandmates at reunion shows, Plant's performances are characterized by his soulful, raw delivery and his ability to evoke a wide range of emotions in listeners. His voice, though mellowed by time, still maintains its power and incredible ability to express deep emotions.  
  
In addition to his musical contributions, Plant's philanthropic endeavors demonstrate his dedication to giving back to society. He has been involved in numerous charitable causes, including supporting the fight against homelessness and raising awareness for cancer research.  
  
Decades after his first steps on the rock stage, Robert Plant remains an influential figure who has left an indelible mark on the music industry. His unique vocal style, boundless creativity, and magnetic stage presence have solidified his place among rock music's most beloved and enduring icons. As he continues to evolve as an artist, Plant's legacy continues to inspire new generations of musicians and fans alike.

Lemi Group esporta il 75% della sua produzione in oltre 100 paesi nel mondo (Europa, USA, Russia, Arabia Saudita e Giappone).  
  
Funzionalità, stile e design italiano, innovazione e tecnologia avanzata: questa è la qualità Lemi.

È una decisione basata sulla qualità, che ci consente di monitorare direttamente l'intero ciclo di vita del prodotto, garantendo soluzioni Made in Italy certificate al 100% con materie prime di prim'ordine e la massima attenzione anche ai dettagli più piccoli.  
  
La totale autonomia ci consente di garantire un'assoluta flessibilità, offrendo soluzioni personalizzate per le vostre diverse esigenze di business. Massima qualità del prodotto, efficienza del servizio totale e garanzia pluriennale.  
  
  
Questo è Lemi Group: un partner prezioso per un business prezioso.

About Brodart
-------------

Brodart knows libraries.  
  
We understand the challenges that libraries face every day: budgets, staffing, and meeting patrons'​ evolving needs, to name a few. Our entire focus as a company is on identifying and helping to address those needs. From custom-made furniture, to shelf-ready books, and expertly curated supplies, Brodart helps libraries serve their patrons successfully.  
  
Books & Library Services  
From opening day to every day. With Brodart, libraries receive the titles that their patrons want, with the flexibility to adapt lists as required, options for lease or purchase, shelf-ready materials processed to exact specifications, and fully customized title-in-hand cataloging. Our opening day collection services feature professional guidance from proposal through delivery.  
  
Custom Furniture  
Brodart furniture features an equal mix of quality and style, enhancing patrons'​ library experience with innovative shelving systems, display products, collaboration furniture, and more. All furniture is made in the USA in our Northeastern Pennsylvania factory. For complex installations, our network of furniture dealers provides comprehensive project management and design support.  
  
Supplies & Furnishings  
We offer the latest supplies and furnishings for today's needs and tomorrow's initiatives. Our product portfolio addresses a range of unique applications, including self-processing, archival, security, learning commons, reading and study, early learning, and STEAM/Makerspace.

The restaurant chain prides itself on its dedication to delivering exceptional service, a principle that remains at the heart of its operations. Chili's employs a variety of technologies to enhance customer experience, including mobile ordering and loyalty programs, which allow guests to enjoy their favorite meals with convenience and ease. The brand's commitment to innovation is matched by its focus on sustainability and community involvement, as it actively participates in local initiatives and charitable efforts.  
  
Chili's serves a broad audience, appealing to families, friends, and casual diners alike, making it a popular choice for gatherings and celebrations. This project not only highlights Vindevogel's forward-thinking approach but also reinforces the brand’s dedication to responsible manufacturing practices. Additionally, his proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and Illustrator has enabled him to create striking visual campaigns that resonate with a global audience, further solidifying Butch Tailors' position in the luxury menswear market.  
  
Vindevogel's persona as a global nomad enriches the brand's narrative, as he travels extensively to connect with clients and source the finest materials from around the world. His exceptional customer service skills ensure that each client receives a personalized experience, resulting in garments that are not only stylish but also deeply meaningful. With a keen eye for detail and a passion for fashion, Dominique Vindevogel continues to redefine the landscape of tailored menswear, making Butch Tailors a go-to destination for those seeking the perfect bespoke suit.

About John Macarthur

John MacArthur is an eminent American minister and author whose profound spiritual insights have touched the lives of millions around the world. With over five decades of ministry experience, MacArthur has emerged as a trailblazer and a voice of authority for Christians seeking guidance and understanding in their faith. Recognized for his unwavering commitment to biblical truth and uncompromising stance on doctrinal accuracy, MacArthur has become a trusted teacher, shepherd, and mentor to countless believers.  
  
Born on June 19, 1939, in Los Angeles, California, John Fullerton MacArthur Jr. grew up in a devout Christian family. His father, Jack MacArthur, was also a minister and served as the pastor of the famous Calvary Bible Church. Under his father's tutelage, MacArthur developed a deep passion for God's Word and a desire to communicate its truths with clarity and precision. Little did he know that this early exposure would eventually shape his calling and the course of his life.  
  
Following his father's footsteps, MacArthur pursued a career in ministry. In 1964, he became the pulpit pastor of the Grace Community Church in Sun Valley, California, a role he still holds today. The church, significantly influenced by MacArthur's teachings, has grown into a vibrant community of believers dedicated to studying and applying the Bible's teachings. MacArthur's gripping delivery style, coupled with his scholarly understanding of Scripture, has made his sermons a cornerstone of the church's success and a source of inspiration for believers worldwide.  
  
Beyond the pulpit, John MacArthur's influence extends through his prolific writing career. He has authored more than 150 books, many of which have become bestsellers, capturing readers' hearts and transforming their understanding of the Christian faith. MacArthur explores a wide range of topics, including theology, biblical interpretation, ministry, and Christian living. His works exhibit a unique blend of scholarly rigor and pastoral application, appealing to both academicians and laypeople seeking spiritual growth.  
  
One of MacArthur's most well-known and influential books, "The Gospel According to Jesus" (1988), caused a significant stir within the evangelical world. In the book, he challenged the popular notion of "easy-believism" by asserting that true salvation is only possible through genuine repentance and surrender to Christ's lordship. The book ignited theological debate and ultimately deepened the understanding of the core tenets of the Christian faith, placing MacArthur at the forefront as a theologian and spiritual guide.  
  
MacArthur's dedication to upholding biblical truth has not only earned him admiration but has also brought about challenges and controversies. In recent years, he has been vocal on issues such as the complimentarian view of gender roles, the inerrancy of Scripture, and his dismissal of the so-called "prosperity gospel." Despite facing criticism from some corners, MacArthur remains steadfast in his commitment to biblical fidelity, prioritizing the Word of God above cultural trends or the approval of men.  
  
As a conference speaker and Bible teacher, John MacArthur has traveled extensively, imparting his wisdom and insight to audiences worldwide. His "Shepherd's Conference," an annual event attracting thousands of pastors and church leaders, equips them with a broad range of ministry tools and aims to uphold the principles of biblical leadership. MacArthur's conferences and seminars have not only educated but also revitalized countless pastors and strengthened their commitment to shepherding their flock with integrity and wisdom.  
  
In recognition of his significant contributions to Christian ministry, MacArthur has received numerous accolades and honors throughout his career. In 2015, The Master's Seminary, an institution that he founded in 1986, launched the "John MacArthur Faculty Chair" in his honor. This not only reflects his impact on the seminary but also emphasizes his enduring legacy as an educator and a voice for biblical fidelity.  
  
In a world filled with spiritual confusion and moral relativism, John MacArthur stands as a beacon of unwavering commitment to biblical truth. His dedication to the authority and sufficiency of Scripture has shaped the lives of countless Christians, offering them a firm foundation and a clear path to holiness. Whether through his sermons, books, or speaking engagements, MacArthur's passion for God's Word continues to inspire and transform the lives of believers, leaving an indelible mark on the fabric of Christianity. In a time marked by theological compromise and spiritual apathy, MacArthur's ministry serves as a rallying cry for Christians to stand firm and sacrificially follow Christ's commands.

Beyond his fighting prowess, Jones has also displayed a deep understanding of martial arts as both a physical and mental discipline. He embodies the ethos of a true martial artist, constantly seeking personal growth and improvement. Jones' commitment to his craft has led him to delve into other disciplines such as Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, Muay Thai, and boxing, allowing him to constantly evolve and adapt his style.  
  
Moreover, Jones' impact extends beyond the octagon. His charisma and ability to captivate audiences have made him a role model for aspiring fighters and fans alike. He has used his platform to advocate for positive change and inspire others to pursue their dreams relentlessly, regardless of the obstacles they may face. Jones has become an ambassador for the sport, showcasing the power of determination, resilience, and discipline in achieving greatness.  
  
As John Jones continues to leave his mark on the world of combat sports, it is clear that his legacy will be one of unrivaled skill and unrivaled success. About John Waters

John Waters is a revolutionary figure in the realm of American filmmaking and writing. With his distinct style and shockingly bold content, he has become an icon of the counterculture since the 1960s. Waters is widely known for his transgressive films that challenge societal norms, featuring themes of subversion, satire, and camp. Along with his unique cinematic vision, he has also made a significant impact as a writer, authoring books that delve into his life experiences and controversial viewpoints. With his eccentric personality and unapologetic approach, John Waters has forever changed the landscape of both film and literature.  
  
Born on April 22, 1946, in Baltimore, Maryland, Waters grew up influenced by the kitschy allure of the city's local television hostesses. This early exposure to camp aesthetics would later become a defining characteristic of his work. Waters attended New York University, where he immersed himself in the artistic and intellectual scene of the 1960s. Inspired by the likes of Andy Warhol and Jean-Luc Godard, he began experimenting with filmmaking. Waters' earliest works, such as "Eat Your Makeup" (1968) and "Mondo Trasho" (1969), were underground films that embodied his unique style and established his reputation as a provocateur.  
  
However, it was with his cult classic "Pink Flamingos" (1972) that Waters truly made his mark on the cinematic landscape. The film tells the story of the filthiest person alive, Divine, as she competes against a rival to retain her title. "Pink Flamingos" pushed boundaries like never before, featuring explicit and controversial scenes that shocked audiences. Despite its initial negative reception, the film gained a dedicated following and has since become a cult favorite. With his subsequent films, including "Female Trouble" (1974) and "Desperate Living" (1977), Waters continued to challenge societal norms and celebrate the fringe.  
  
In addition to his filmmaking career, Waters has achieved success as a writer. His first book, "Shock Value" (1981), is a collection of essays that provide an intimate look into his life, influences, and unconventional perspective. With his trademark wit and candid storytelling, Waters navigates topics such as his love for trash culture, his obsession with true crime, and his experiences growing up in Baltimore. "Shock Value" solidified Waters' reputation as an irreverent and subversive cultural figure.  
  
Throughout his career, Waters has continued to release films that defy convention and blur the line between art and trash. "Hairspray" (1988), a musical comedy set in 1960s Baltimore, marked a shift toward more mainstream success for the filmmaker. The film's heartwarming story, combined with Waters' signature camp sensibility, resonated with audiences and eventually spawned a successful Broadway adaptation and a later film adaptation directed by Adam Shankman in 2007. Despite his newfound fame, Waters has never compromised his unique style or outspoken views, remaining true to his artistic vision.  
  
In recent years, Waters has extended his talents to various mediums, including visual arts, photography, and performances. His photography series, "Rear Projection" (2004), explores the concept of celebrity, using rear projection techniques to superimpose his subjects onto recognizable backgrounds. The series captures both the glamour and artificiality of fame, blurring the lines between reality and illusion. Waters has also embarked on spoken word tours, sharing his personal anecdotes and stories in a humorous and engaging manner.  
  
With his irreverent style and subversive content, John Waters has cemented his status as an influential figure in American culture. His films and writings continue to inspire and challenge, proving that art has the power to provoke and push boundaries. Whether through his cult classics like "Pink Flamingos" or his best-selling books like "Shock Value," Waters fearlessly confronts societal norms and celebrates all that is considered taboo. Through his unwavering commitment to his artistic vision, John Waters has left an indelible mark on the world of filmmaking and writing, forever redefining the boundaries of creative expression.

What types of services does INSA provide to its members?

INSA offers a variety of services to its members, including networking opportunities, access to exclusive events and forums, and resources for professional development. Members can participate in roundtable discussions, webinars, and workshops that focus on current issues in national security and intelligence. Additionally, INSA provides a platform for members to collaborate on public-private partnerships that address pressing challenges in the intelligence community.

How does INSA facilitate public-private partnerships in the intelligence community?

INSA facilitates public-private partnerships by bringing together leaders from government, industry, and academia to discuss and develop solutions to national security challenges. Through events, working groups, and collaborative projects, INSA fosters dialogue and cooperation between sectors, helping to align resources and expertise to enhance national security efforts. This collaborative approach ensures that innovative solutions are developed and implemented effectively.

Who can become a member of INSA, and what are the benefits?

Membership in INSA is open to individuals and organizations involved in the national security and intelligence sectors, including government officials, industry leaders, and academic professionals. Benefits of membership include access to exclusive events, networking opportunities, participation in working groups, and the ability to influence policy discussions. Members also receive insights and updates on industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies relevant to national security.

What industries does INSA support, and how does it impact national security?

INSA supports a wide range of industries that play a crucial role in national security, including defense, cybersecurity, intelligence technology, and critical infrastructure. By fostering collaboration among these industries, INSA helps to drive innovation and improve the effectiveness of national security initiatives. The alliance works to ensure that the intelligence community has access to the latest technologies and practices, ultimately enhancing the nation's ability to address security threats.

How can I get involved with INSA's initiatives and events?

Individuals interested in getting involved with INSA can join as members or participate in specific initiatives and events. Membership provides access to a variety of programs and resources. Additionally, INSA regularly hosts events such as conferences, panel discussions, and networking receptions that are open to members and non-members alike. Interested parties can visit the INSA website for information on upcoming events, volunteer opportunities, and ways to engage with ongoing initiatives.

What role does INSA play in shaping national security policy?

INSA plays a significant role in shaping national security policy by serving as a nonpartisan forum for discussion and collaboration among stakeholders in the intelligence community. The organization conducts research, publishes reports, and hosts events that highlight key issues and challenges facing national security. By providing a platform for dialogue and sharing best practices, INSA influences policy decisions and promotes effective strategies that enhance the nation's security posture.

What services does Navigating Cancer provide for oncology care?

Navigating Cancer offers a comprehensive suite of digital oncology solutions designed to enhance patient engagement and streamline care delivery. Key services include digital triage, electronic patient-reported outcomes (ePRO), telehealth capabilities, and a robust patient portal. These tools help healthcare providers monitor patients' conditions, track side effects, and facilitate communication between patients and their care teams, ultimately improving the overall oncology care experience.

How does Navigating Cancer support patient engagement?

Navigating Cancer prioritizes patient engagement through its innovative digital solutions. The patient portal allows individuals to access their health information, communicate with their care teams, and manage appointments. Additionally, the platform includes educational resources tailored to cancer patients, enabling them to better understand their diagnosis and treatment options. By fostering active participation in their care, Navigating Cancer helps patients feel more empowered and informed throughout their treatment journey.

What industries does Navigating Cancer serve?

Navigating Cancer primarily serves the oncology sector, providing solutions that cater to healthcare providers, pharmaceutical companies, and cancer treatment centers. By integrating ePRO into their digital solutions, Navigating Cancer empowers patients to take an active role in their care, leading to more personalized treatment approaches and improved patient outcomes.

Navigating Cancer is committed to adhering to HITECH and Meaningful Use standards by implementing robust data security measures and ensuring that its digital solutions facilitate the meaningful exchange of health information. The company's technology is designed to support healthcare providers in meeting regulatory requirements while improving patient care. By leveraging advanced analytics and reporting capabilities, Navigating Cancer helps practices demonstrate compliance and optimize their use of electronic health records (EHRs) in oncology care.

About Liam Costner

Liam Costner is making his own mark on the entertainment industry as the talented son of the legendary actor, Kevin Costner. Born into a prestigious Hollywood family, Liam possesses the innate talent and magnetic charisma that runs in his genes. While many may naturally compare him to his famous father, Liam is forging his own path as an actor and musician, determined to prove that he has what it takes to captivate audiences on his own merit.  
  
Growing up in the shadows of his father's success, Liam was exposed to the magic of cinema from an early age. Surrounded by iconic film sets, he absorbed the art of storytelling and developed an appreciation for the craft of acting. Inspired by the performances of his father and other renowned actors, Liam knew he had a calling to follow in their footsteps. He honed his acting skills at the prestigious Lee Strasberg Theatre and Film Institute, where he trained with revered acting mentors and studied the techniques of the greats.  
  
Liam made his acting debut in 2013, starring alongside his father in the critically acclaimed film "Man of Steel." The poignant father-son dynamic on screen mirrored their real-life relationship, creating an emotional depth in their performances. Liam's portrayal of a young version of his father's character gained praise from both audiences and critics, indicating his potential as a rising star in the making. Following this successful debut, Liam continued to showcase his acting prowess in a variety of projects, taking on challenging roles that pushed his boundaries and allowed him to explore different genres and characters.  
  
Despite being Kevin Costner's son, Liam is determined to carve out his own niche and create a unique identity in the industry. He understands that comparisons are inevitable, but he embraces the challenge, eager to prove his individuality as an artist. While his last name opens doors, it is his natural talent and dedication that will ultimately determine his success. Liam is keen to develop a diverse body of work, constantly seeking projects that will challenge and push him to new heights.  
  
In addition to acting, Liam is a skilled musician and songwriter. About CODA Biotherapeutics
--------------------------

CODA Biotherapeutics’ revolutionary chemogenetic platform aims to control the activity of cells to treat disease. With chemogenetics, the goal is to modify a target cell population using gene therapy to express a tunable “switch” protein. Cells modified with the “switch” can be activated or inactivated in a dose-dependent manner by a subsequently administered small molecule therapeutic, an effect that should only occur in the modified cells.  
  
CODA’s engineered receptors will be able to modulate the activity of virtually any cell in which the receptor is ectopically expressed, making them suitable for the treatment of many disorders. CODA can further tailor the therapy to a particular disease by simply changing the viral capsid, DNA regulatory elements, and route of administration.

About Semma Therapeutics
------------------------

Type 1 diabetes (T1D) is a chronic, life-threatening disease that affects millions of people worldwide. T1D is an autoimmune disease in which the patient’s immune system attacks and destroys pancreatic beta cells, which are responsible for regulating blood sugar levels by producing precise amounts of insulin. The discovery of injectable insulin in the 1920s changed T1D from a fatal disease to one that could be carefully managed through multiple daily blood glucose measurements and insulin injections. However, patients still face a lifetime of difficult disease management and serious complications including kidney failure, blindness and nerve damage. Nearly a century later, insulin injection remains the only treatment available to patients.  
  
Semma Therapeutics was founded to develop transformative therapies for patients who currently depend on insulin injections. Recent work led to the discovery of a method to generate billions of functional, insulin-producing beta cells in the laboratory. These cells develop in islet-like clusters grown from stem cells. Initial preclinical work in animal models of diabetes has shown that transplantation of these cells is sufficient to control blood glucose levels. This breakthrough technology has been exclusively licensed to Semma Therapeutics for the development of a cell-based therapy for diabetes.  
  
Ongoing research at Semma Therapeutics is focused on combining these proprietary cells with a state-of-the-art device that can protect these cells from the patient’s immune system and allow the beta cells to function as they do in non-diabetic individuals. Implantation of the beta cell-filled device has the potential to provide a true replacement for the missing beta cells in a diabetic patient and would not require patient immunosuppression. Semma Therapeutics is working to bring this new therapeutic option to the clinic and improve the lives of patients with diabetes.

About ViaCyte
-------------

About ViaCyte  
  
ViaCyte is a privately held regenerative medicine company developing novel cell replacement therapies as potential long-term diabetes treatments to achieve glucose control targets and reduce the risk of hypoglycemia and diabetes-related complications. ViaCyte’s product candidates are based on directed differentiation of pluripotent stem cells into PEC-01 pancreatic islet progenitor cells, which are then implanted in durable and retrievable cell delivery devices. ViaCyte demonstrated that when effectively engrafted, PEC-01 cells can mature into glucose-responsive insulin producing cells in patients with type 1 diabetes. To accelerate and expand its efforts, ViaCyte has established collaborative partnerships with leading companies including CRISPR Therapeutics and W.L. Gore & Associates.  
  
About ViaCyte’s Pipeline  
  
The PEC-Direct product candidate, currently being evaluated in the clinic, delivers ViaCyte’s PEC-01 cells (pancreatic islet progenitor cells) in a non-immunoprotective device and is being developed for type 1 diabetes patients who have hypoglycemia unawareness, extreme glycemic lability, and/or recurrent severe hypoglycemic episodes. The PEC-Encap (also known as VC-01) product candidate, also undergoing clinical evaluation, delivers the same pancreatic islet progenitor cells but in an immunoprotective device. PEC-Encap is being developed for all patients with type 1 diabetes. In collaboration with CRISPR Therapeutics, ViaCyte is developing immune-evasive stem cell lines from its proprietary CyT49 cell line. These immune-evasive stem cell lines, which are being used in the PEC-QT program, have the potential to further broaden the availability of cell therapy for all patients with insulin-requiring diabetes, type 1 and type 2. In addition, a pluripotent, immune evasive cell line has the potential to be used to produce any cell in the body, thus enabling many other potential indications.

Do you deliver to all areas in North Carolina?

Yes, R.A. Jeffreys provides delivery services throughout North Carolina, from Raleigh to Wilmington. We strive to ensure that our customers have access to our extensive beer selection no matter where they are located within the state.

Can I order specialty beers from R.A. Jeffreys?

Does R.A. Jeffreys offer any promotions or discounts?

We wanted to combine our knowledge to provide industry-defining services—without being owned by a broker or private equity company. So we joined forces and created a truly unique and personalized experience for employers and employees.  
  
At TOC, we lean on decades of lessons learned and relationships built. We leverage your technology and provide top-tier implementation staff. Our communications team, comprised of award-winning writers, graphic designers, film producers and directors, creates your customized content. We invest the time to get to know every client company so we can seamlessly guide employees through benefits enrollment. Your employees will feel engaged and appreciated throughout the process –because they will be engaged and appreciated.  
What sets us apart? Our experience and our passion for perfection. Our team is lean, efficient, and motivated. We don’t aim to be the biggest. We aim to be the best.  
  
We set out to create the ideal enrollment company. We’re proud to say, we did it—and our clients agree.

About ICON Engineering Pty Ltd
------------------------------

ICON Engineering is an innovative, fast-response oilfield service company offering a range of services including facilities engineering services from concept through to construction, offshore installation and contracting, drilling rig modifications, repairs and upgrades, and specialty subsea oilfield equipment supply.  
  
Formed in 1997, ICON has a long track record of providing cost effective and practical construction solutions, novel equipment development for drilling applications and innovative facilities designs aimed at reducing offshore construction risk. ICON also provides services for onshore oilfield developments.  
  
ICON has successfully executed hundreds of projects spanning the world’s major oil provinces including projects in Australia, , Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, New Zealand, PNG, USA, Canada, Singapore and the UK. We understand local requirements and provide solutions and adapt our work methods to suit.  
  
ICON have experienced management and personnel with an impeccable record of safely delivering projects. We execute projects using teams taking projects from study phases through to completion. Typically key personnel stay with the project; as a consequence our conceptual engineering has a strong practical influence. ICON personnel have skills covering exploration, drilling, conceptual design, detailed design, offshore construction, hook-up, operations and maintenance.  
  
The slogan “Legendary Innovations, Practical Solutions” is testament to our engineering capabilities and attitude.

Snappy is committed to enhancing the joy of gift giving and recently expanded its suite of offerings to include a consumer-facing gifting platform, as well as Snappy Lite, the self-service solution for small businesses to send gifts to employees and customers.  
  
Snappy is headquartered in New York City and has a global team across four countries. Snappy is featured on Fortune’s "Best Small & Medium Workplaces," “Best Workplace for Millennials,” and “Best Workplace in Tech” lists.
