About PSA Parts Ltd
-------------------

PSA Parts Ltd is a pan-European manufacturer and distributor of IT spares and consumer electronics. With over 30 years’ experience and a trusted reputation, PSA supplies over 4,000 branded product lines, is a Licensee for Duracell and is 2-POWER’s master distributor across Europe. Additionally, PSA offers OEM brands on products such as laptop docking stations, memory, keyboards and LCD panels.  
  
Operating a distribution network across three continents, PSA offers international fulfilment either via its two distribution centres or on FOB terms. PSA’s multi-lingual team of experienced account managers based in London and across Europe, work in close communication with a broad customer base and provide first-class service levels.  
  
As a licensee for Duracell, the world’s number one consumer battery brand, PSA markets a variety of power solutions for laptop, smartphone, digital camera and UPS. A new range of automotive products featuring jump-starters, inverters, battery chargers and maintainers has added depth to the Duracell branded range that PSA offers.  
  
Continuous innovation, growth, and success have been the bedrock of PSA’s evolution for over three decades.  
  
If you are a brand with licensing opportunities, in need of help with complex distribution requirements, or an individual looking to take a new career path in a fast-paced environment with high levels of responsibility, then please get in touch.  
  
To speak to a member of our team or browse our products, please visit www.psaparts.co.uk  
  
Regards

About Henry Vi

Henry VI was the King of England from 1422 to 1461 and then again from 1470 to 1471, making him one of the longest-reigning monarchs in English history. However, his reign was marked by political instability, military defeats, and mental illness, leading to a period of intense conflict known as the Wars of the Roses. Born on December 6, 1421, Henry VI ascended to the throne at the tender age of nine months following the death of his father, King Henry V. His early years were overshadowed by the ongoing Hundred Years' War with France, and by the time he reached adulthood, Henry VI faced numerous challenges to his rule, both from within his own court and from powerful noble families seeking to increase their influence.  
  
Despite his attempts to rule wisely and justly, Henry VI's reign was plagued by weaknesses in leadership, which allowed the nobility to pursue their own agendas and led to widespread instability. His inability to maintain control over the nobility and government institutions led to a series of power struggles and rebellions, ultimately resulting in the outbreak of the Wars of the Roses, a decades-long struggle for the English throne between the houses of Lancaster and York. Henry VI's reign was characterized by a lack of strong leadership, as he was often influenced and manipulated by others, most notably his ambitious wife, Margaret of Anjou.  
  
The Wars of the Roses, which began during Henry VI's reign, were a series of civil wars that tore England apart and resulted in significant loss of life. The conflict was fueled by a power struggle between the rival noble factions, each claiming a legitimate right to the throne. The Lancastrian faction, led by Henry VI and his queen, Margaret of Anjou, represented the House of Lancaster, while the Yorkist faction, led by Richard, Duke of York, and his son Edward, claimed descent from the rival House of York. The war was marked by a series of battles and shifting allegiances between the two sides, each seeking to gain the upper hand and secure the throne for their respective claimants.  
  
Henry VI's reign was further complicated by his mental health issues, which made him unable to effectively govern the kingdom. He suffered from bouts of mental illness, which left him incapacitated and unable to make decisions. This created a power vacuum at the heart of the government, allowing the nobles and their factions to vie for control. The struggle for power and influence among the nobility, combined with Henry VI's inability to intervene effectively, led to a period of intense instability and conflict within the kingdom.  
  
Despite the chaos and turmoil that characterized his reign, Henry VI is remembered for his piety and his efforts to promote learning and education. He founded Eton College and King's College, Cambridge, and was a patron of the arts and literature. His reign also saw the development of the English language, as writers such as Geoffrey Chaucer and John Lydgate produced some of their most celebrated works during this period. However, these cultural achievements were overshadowed by the political and military struggles that dominated his reign.  
  
In 1461, Henry VI was deposed and imprisoned by the Yorkist faction under Edward IV, effectively bringing an end to his first reign. Although he was briefly restored to the throne in 1470, his second reign lasted only a few months before he was once again deposed by Edward IV. Henry VI spent the remainder of his life in captivity, and his death in 1471 marked the end of the direct Lancastrian line and the beginning of the Tudor dynasty, with the accession of Henry VI's distant relative, Henry VII. Henry VI's reign was a turbulent and troubled period in English history, marked by political instability, military conflict, and the collapse of royal authority. His legacy is one of weakness and division, as his inability to provide strong leadership allowed the Wars of the Roses to escalate and plunge England into a prolonged and devastating civil war.

About CarbExplore Research BV
-----------------------------

CarbExplore Research develops proprietary enzymes for the manufacture of functional carbohydrates. The core technology is based on identifying novel glucansucrase, glucantransferase, inulosucrase, and beta-galactosidase enzymes. Renewable materials such as sugar, starch and lactose are converted into high-margin carbohydrates with health and physical benefits. The alpha-glucans find their use as prebiotics with texturizing properties in foods and cosmetics. Our product portfolio consists of carbohydrate-based stevia sweeteners, anti-staling agents for baking, rheology modifiers, human milk oligosaccharides (HMOs) and galacto-and fructooligosaccharides (GOS-FOS).  
  
To support carbohydrate development, an extensive package of carbohydrate analysis and structure elucidation is offered. CarbExplore Research is looking for contact research collaborations within the fields of food, nutrition, and nutraceuticals. Our technology contributes to a sustainable and healthy society.

Green Dot offers a broad set of financial services to consumers and businesses including debit, checking, credit, prepaid, and payroll cards, as well as robust money processing services, tax refunds, cash deposits and disbursements. Its flagship digital banking platform GO2bank offers consumers simple and accessible mobile banking designed to help improve financial health over time. The company’s banking platform services business enables a growing list of the world’s largest and most trusted consumer and technology brands to deploy customized, seamless, value-driven money management solutions for their customers.

About Good Technology
---------------------

Good Technology (established in 1996) is a mobile security solutions provider headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, United States. The company serves more than 6,000 organizations worldwide in industries such as financial services, healthcare, manufacturing, energy and utilities, legal, government, and technology. Good makes products for managing and securing mobile data and devices in a business environment. Today’s Good Technology is a continuation of the company as founded in 2000, but also of internet pioneer Visto, founded in 1996, which acquired and assumed the name of Good Technology in 2009. Good Technology holds the longest track record for innovation in secure mobility, with more than 270 patents granted or pending, and many prestigious industry awards. Good Technology has continued to expand its portfolio through corporate acquisitions, including Intercasting Corporation (May 2009), Copiun (2012), AppCentral (2012), BoxTone (2014), Fixmo (2014) and Macheen (2014). Good’s comprehensive solution consists of a secure mobility platform, mobile device management, mobile service management, a suite of collaboration applications, and a broad third-party application and partner ecosystem. The Good Dynamics Secure Mobility Platform serves as a foundation for the Good Collaboration Suite, and also for the Good Mobile Alliance ISV Ecosystem, in which independent developers create and distribute apps of their own leveraging Good’s leading security framework. Part of the Good Dynamics Secure Mobility Platform, Good’s mobile service management provides organizations with real-time end-to-end visibility and efficient support by proactively monitoring multiple mobile services through a ‘single pane of glass’ including Good for Enterprise, Microsoft Exchange ActiveSync, BlackBerry and messaging proxy services. The Good Collaboration Suite includes Good for Enterprise, Good Share, Good Connect and Good Access secure mobile apps. These apps simplify access to email, calendar, contacts, tasks, instant messaging, browsing and document sharing, and are built using Good’s next-gen containerization model that enables secure data sharing and app-level encryption independent of the device used. Good for Enterprise, the core component of the Collaboration Suite, provides a strict separation between personal and corporate content, allowing both to coexist on an employee's device without compromising security. In September 2013 the company’s Good for Enterprise (GFE) solution became the first cross-platform mobile collaboration solution to achieve Common Criteria Evaluation Assurance Level 4 Augmented (EAL4+) and the only containerized solution to meet this level of security certification on either iOS or Android. Other recognition includes: \* Good Technology is a Leader in Gartner’s EMM Suites Magic Quadrant for the 4th consecutive year (2014) \* Good Technology is a Leader in Forrester's EMM Wave (2014) \* Good Technology is a Leader in IDC's EMM Marketscape (2014) \* Good Technology is a Leader in Aragon's EMM Globe (2014) Visto acquired Good Technology in 2009 and renamed itself as the acquired company.

About ServU Federal Credit Union
--------------------------------

ServU Federal Credit Union is a full service financial alternative to a bank. As a member owned financial cooperative, credit unions are not-for-profit. They function to serve their membership. As a result, credit unions are able to pay back higher dividends on savings and charge lower interest on loans. Money that is made by the credit union after overhead is returned to the members as dividends and other financial services. The Credit Union is overseen by a volunteer Board of Directors. These Board members are elected each year by the credit union membership.  
  
Today over 35,000 people in Steuben, Schuyler, Yates and Allegany counties enjoy the benefits of ServU Credit Union membership.

About Lotus Development Corporation
-----------------------------------

Lotus Software (called Lotus Development Corporation before its acquisition by IBM) is a software company with headquarters in Westford, Massachusetts. Lotus is most commonly known for the Lotus 1-2-3 spreadsheet application, the first feature-heavy, user friendly, reliable and WYSIWYG-enabled product to become widely available in the early days of the IBM PC, when there was no Graphical User Interface. Such a useful tool certainly helped to spread the adoption of the PC, both for administrative and scientific applications. Much later, in conjunction with Ray Ozzie's Iris Associates, Lotus also released a groupware and email system, Lotus Notes. IBM purchased the company in 1995 for $3.5 billion, primarily to acquire Lotus Notes and to establish a presence in the increasingly important client-server computing segment, which was rapidly making host-based products like IBM's OfficeVision obsolete. Source: Wikipedia , accessed 2/12/10.

About Kelly Ripka

Kelly Ripa is an American actress and talk show host who has become a household name in the entertainment industry. With her charming personality and quick wit, Ripa has charmed audiences on both the small and big screens for over three decades. Born in Stratford, New Jersey, Ripa began her career in the early 1990s, landing her breakthrough role as Hayley Vaughan on the popular soap opera "All My Children."  
  
Ripa's portrayal of Hayley Vaughan immediately captured the attention of viewers and critics alike, earning her widespread acclaim and a Daytime Emmy Award nomination. Her work on "All My Children" propelled her into the spotlight and set the stage for her subsequent success in the entertainment industry. After departing from the soap opera in 2002, Ripa transitioned seamlessly into television hosting, co-hosting "Live! with Regis and Kelly" alongside Regis Philbin. The duo's on-screen chemistry and banter made the morning talk show a hit, and Ripa quickly became a beloved figure in daytime television.  
  
In 2011, Ripa began co-hosting "Live! with Kelly and Michael" with former NFL star Michael Strahan, further solidifying her status as a prominent figure in the talk show circuit. Her infectious energy and ability to connect with audiences endeared her to viewers across the country, making her a highly sought-after personality in the world of daytime television. Ripa's success as a talk show host has earned her numerous accolades, including several Daytime Emmy Award nominations and a win for Outstanding Talk Show Host.  
  
In addition to her work on daytime television, Ripa has also made notable appearances in film and television. She has showcased her comedic talents in projects such as "Marvin's Room" and "Hope & Faith," further demonstrating her versatility as an actress. Ripa's natural charisma and magnetic presence have made her a sought-after guest on various television programs, further cementing her status as a beloved figure in the entertainment industry.  
  
Beyond her work in front of the camera, Ripa has also made a name for herself as a savvy businesswoman. She co-founded Milojo Productions, a production company that has produced successful projects such as "Homemade Millionaire" and "Change of Heart." Ripa's entrepreneurial spirit and creative vision have allowed her to expand her influence beyond the realm of entertainment, positioning her as a formidable force in the industry.  
  
Off-screen, Ripa is a dedicated philanthropist and advocate for numerous charitable causes. She has used her platform to raise awareness for issues such as childhood cancer and environmental conservation, using her influence to make a positive impact in the world. Ripa's commitment to giving back has earned her admiration and respect from fans and peers alike, showcasing her unwavering dedication to making a difference in the lives of others.  
  
In all aspects of her career, Kelly Ripa continues to captivate audiences with her magnetic charisma and vibrant personality. Whether she's entertaining viewers on a talk show or bringing characters to life on-screen, Ripa's talent and charm have solidified her status as a beloved figure in the entertainment industry. With her enduring appeal and unwavering passion for her craft, Ripa's influence will undoubtedly continue to resonate for years to come.

About Loghis Logística e Serviços Ltda.
---------------------------------------

Loghis Logística e Serviços Ltda. is a leading provider of integrated logistics solutions in Brazil, headquartered in Taubaté, São Paulo. With over 15 years of experience in the logistics sector, Loghis has established itself as a forward-thinking company that leverages the latest technologies, methodologies, and processes to meet the evolving needs of its clients. The company offers a comprehensive suite of services, including transportation, warehousing, intralogistics, international logistics, and logistics engineering, making it a one-stop solution for businesses seeking to optimize their supply chain operations.  
  
Loghis serves a diverse range of industries, ensuring that each client receives tailored solutions that enhance efficiency and reduce costs. About Alliance for Women in Media
---------------------------------

The Alliance for Women in Media (AWM) is a non-profit, professional organization of women and men who work in the media and allied fields.  
Our Mission  
  
The mission of AWM is to advance the impact of women in the media and allied fields by educating, advocating and acting as a resource to our members, the industry, and the public.  
  
Our Goals  
  
\* Work to improve the quality of the media;  
\* Promote the entry, development and advancement of women in the media and allied fields;  
\* Serve as a medium of communication and idea exchange; and  
\* Become involved in community concerns.  
  
Our History  
  
AWM was formed as American Women in Radio and Television in 1951 as successor to the National Association of Broadcasters (NAB) women's division. NAB voted approval of the new organization, offering complete cooperation and assistance.

Since 1890, our dedicated employees have been supporting customers and delivering on promises to improve the quality of life through transformative mass transit solutions. From initial design through final assembly, each GILLIG bus is designed and built by American workers in Livermore, California, who are committed to building and supporting the safest and most reliable transit buses in the United States.  
  
GILLIG buses are known for their unmatched quality and have earned their reputation as the lowest-cost buses to maintain and operate. Our products help reduce congestion, contribute to a cleaner environment,​ and provide mobility to all. Customers know they will find value in every visit as inventory turns continually creating a “treasure hunt” shopping experience. About CERT
----------

CERT is the cyber security management division of the Software Engineering Institute that is focused on improving the security and resilience of computer systems and networks. It is focused on areas such as data collection and mining, statistics and trend analysis, computer and network security, incident management, insider threat, software assurance, and more. The CERT Division works closely with the Department of Homeland Security. It provides exercises, courses, and systems that were designed, implemented, and delivered to DHS and its customers as part of the SEI's mission to transition SEI capabilities to the public and private sectors and improve the practice of cybersecurity. CERT is in partnership with government, industry, law enforcement, and academia personnel to develop advanced methods and technologies to counter large-scale, sophisticated cyber threats. CERT was founded in 1988 and is based in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania.

Con más de 120 años de experiencia, la CMU (Compañía Madrileña de Urbanización), es hoy el resultado del esfuerzo, del saber hacer y de una acertada estrategia que nos han permitido superar las distintas crisis y ser hoy una de las empresas inmobiliarias más consolidadas del sector.  
  
A lo largo de todos estos años, CMU ha sabido adaptarse a las necesidades y exigencias del mercado inmobiliario de forma ágil y efectiva.  
  
CMU cuenta con gran experiencia en desarrollo de suelo y grandes proyectos urbanísticos, llevando a cabo todas las actividades relacionadas con la gestión de suelo y desarrollo de promociones inmobiliarias. Contamos para ello con la experiencia del equipo gestor y con la colaboración de arquitectos y abogados urbanistas de dilatada experiencia.  
  
Actualmente, la Compañía Madrileña de Urbanización, goza de una posición consolidada en el mercado inmobiliario gracias a su excelente capacidad de gestión, profesionalidad y solvencia financiera.  
  
La actividad de CMU se ha desarrollado en la Comunidad de Madrid, estando presente en los principales desarrollos urbanísticos: Ciudad Lineal, Las Rosas, Las Tablas, Montecarmelo, Gandhi, Fuencarral-Malmea, Vallecas y prolongación de la Castellana.

What types of services does the Software Engineering Institute (SEI) offer?

The Software Engineering Institute (SEI) offers a wide range of services focused on improving software engineering practices, cybersecurity, and artificial intelligence. We also provide support for organizations looking to implement Agile methodologies and DevSecOps practices.

How does SEI support cybersecurity initiatives?

SEI supports cybersecurity initiatives through a comprehensive approach that includes research on emerging threats, development of innovative technologies, and practical solutions for organizations. We offer services such as cybersecurity assessments, digital forensics, insider threat analysis, and training programs to enhance the skills of the cyber workforce. Our focus on cyber risk and resilience helps organizations to better prepare for and respond to cyber incidents.

What industries does SEI work with?

What is SEI's approach to artificial intelligence and machine learning?

SEI's approach to artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) involves researching and developing innovative technologies that address complex problems in software engineering and cybersecurity. We focus on creating practical applications of AI and ML, including human-machine interaction, autonomy and counter-autonomy, and data modeling and analytics. Our goal is to transition these advanced technologies into practice, helping organizations leverage AI and ML for improved decision-making and operational efficiency.

How can organizations engage with SEI for consulting services?

Organizations can engage with SEI for consulting services by reaching out through our website or contacting our business development team directly. About Cloudfind
---------------

Cloudfind helps enterprises find, share and organize information in the cloud, with an automated file tagging engine correlating related information between files in cloud storage (such as Google Drive, Box) and SaaS applications (such as Salesforce.com). The rise of cloud storage and SaaS are highlighting limitations of conventional search and collaboration tools. Search returns many results that still need to be reviewed manually, and content management systems are often incompatible with the cloud storage paradigm. Cloudfind’s SaaS-based technology provides a much more effective solution to the problem of linking business processes with the right information from potentially millions of files, dramatically streamlining many day-to-day business processes. For enterprise users and teams, Cloudfind incorporates a fundamentally new way to manage information. Cloudfind automatically tags information from cloud files in a more intelligent way than keyword search and without relying on user-specified tags. Cloudfind is integrated with Salesforce.com, Google Drive, Box and DropBox, giving Sales users seamless access to cloud-based storage with the potential for dramatic productivity improvements. Cloudfind works both directly with customers as well as with Salesforce.com implementation partners who incorporate its technology within larger solutions. The company is privately held with angel investors including former executives from Geneva and LinkDex.

Thirty Tigers: independent music marketing/distribution and artist management.  
  
Marketing & Distribution  
Thirty Tigers Marketing and Distribution provides independent artists a way to bring their art to the market place, while maintaining ownership of their recordings. Our team will guide their music to the masses via traditional brick & mortar record stores, digital retailers and streaming services; on the demand side we assist our clients in implementing a plan that will help raise their visibility above the din of noise that exists in today’s media space. This is done with our in house veteran sales, marketing and promotion team.  
  
Management  
Thirty Tigers Management strives to help artists define their vision and achieve it. We value creativity, honesty and a solid work ethic in ourselves and our artists. We believe in building careers. We believe that we can deliver results in our artist’s best interest, while still treating people the way that we’d like to be treated. Our managers collectively have expertise and relationships in label management, artist development, retail sales, touring, digital sales and marketing, festival development, publicity, radio promotion, and more.

Today, more than half of the best-selling games are using Havok technology and our partners continue to push the limits of gaming, bringing players more immersion, more thrills, and more fun.  
  
Havok products are supported and optimized across all major platforms, including Nintendo Switch, PlayStation®, and Xbox. We provide integrations for Unity and Unreal Engine and are used in countless proprietary game engines.  
  
and... Havok’s products have also been used to drive special effects in movie franchises such as Harry Potter, Clash of the Titans, Watchmen, James Bond, and The Matrix.  
  
Havok’s consistent commitment to providing high-quality technology has not gone unnoticed. For five years in a row (2008-2012), Havok Physics was the winner of the Front Line Award for Best Middleware and a sixth all-time win for Havok software, which also took the award for Best Game Component in 2003. About Adel Kalemcilik
---------------------

Türkiye’de kalem denince ilk akla gelen ve bir geleneğe dönüşen Adel Kalemcilik 1969’da İstanbul-Kartal’daki fabrikasının açılışıyla faaliyete geçti. Adel’in ürettiği kalemler ve kırtasiye ürünleri yüksek kaliteleri ile tüm Türkiye’de tanındı, nesillerin eğitiminde önemli yer aldı.  
  
Adel gerek üretim miktarları, gerekse ürün çeşitliliği açısından Türkiye’nin ve yakın coğrafyanın en büyük kırtasiye ürünleri üreticisi konumundadır. Avrupa genelindeki ağaç cidarlı kalemlerin üretiminin yaklaşık %13'ü Adel tarafından gerçekleşiyor.  
  
Dünyanın en eski yazım gereçleri firması olan Faber-Castell ile kuruluşundan bu yana sürdürdüğü işbirliğini 1995 yılında ortaklıkla pekiştiren Adel, bu ortaklığın gücü ile Türkiye’ye değer katan yatırımlarını ara vermeden sürdürüyor.  
  
1996 yılında halka açılan Adel’in günümüzde %27,70’lık payı, Borsa İstanbul’da işlem görüyor. Son 5 yıllık ortalama temettü verimliliğinde ise ilk 25 firma arasında bulunuyor.  
  
Adel, Türkiye kırtasiye sektörünün lideri olarak İstanbul’daki üretim tesisinde; ağaç cidarlı kurşun kalemler, boya ve kopya kalemleri, tükenmez, mekanik kurşun kalemler ve minleri, sıvı mürekkepli kalemler, keçeli kalemler, pastel boyalar, suluboyalar, silgiler, parmak boyası, oyun hamuru ve guaj boya üretiyor.  
  
Özünde barındırdığı “iyilik” değeri ile eğitimin ve eğitimde yaratıcılığın en büyük destekçisi olan Adel Kalemcilik, çok sayıda sponsorluk ve sosyal sorumluluk projesini yürütüyor.  
  
2014 yılında 45. yılını kutlayan Adel, 60’a yakın ülkeye ihracat yapıyor. Temmuz 2015’de Çayırova’daki yeni üretim tesisine taşınan Adel Kalemcilik; perakende sektöründeki deneyimi ve geniş bayi ağıyla yeni bir kulvarın oyuncusu oldu. Kendi yarattığı Adeland markası dışında; Auldey, Lotus, WOW ve NICI gibi dünyanın önde gelen markaları ile 2015 yılında oyuncak sektörüne de girdi.  
  
Markaları: Faber-Castell, Graf von Faber-Castell, Eberhard Faber, Adel, Adeland, Atlas, Max, Auldey, Lotus, WOW ve NICI

Juliet Curry currently serves as the Branch Director at the Boys & Girls Clubs of Santa Monica, where she leverages her two decades of experience in program and curriculum development to create impactful, high-quality arts programming for youth. Her deep understanding of child development and K-12 art standards allows her to design innovative initiatives that not only engage students but also foster their creative expression and personal growth. Under her leadership, the club has become a beacon of hope and opportunity for families in need, as she champions a culture of inclusivity and support.  
  
One of Juliet's key projects includes the implementation of a comprehensive art enrichment program that integrates blended learning techniques, allowing students to explore their artistic talents while developing critical thinking and problem-solving skills. By fostering a safe and inspiring environment, she has elevated the club's reputation and significantly increased member engagement. Her commitment to student leadership is evident in her efforts to train and develop a high-performing team, ensuring that staff are equipped with the tools and resources necessary to support the diverse needs of the community.  
  
Juliet's innovative leadership style is characterized by her ability to think creatively and introduce new ideas that resonate with both students and their families. She actively engages in community outreach initiatives, building partnerships that enhance the club's offerings and expand its reach. With a strong focus on operations management and budget oversight, Juliet ensures that the club operates efficiently while maximizing its impact on the lives of the young people it serves. Her dedication to fostering a nurturing environment and her expertise in art education make her a pivotal figure in shaping the future of the Boys & Girls Clubs of Santa Monica.

About R&D Tax Credit Experts
----------------------------

Claim R&D Tax Credits - let the Experts with a very high success rate deal with your claim  
  
R&D tax relief is a government incentive aimed at encouraging companies of all sizes and in all sectors to invest in innovation by allowing companies to claim enhanced tax relief on qualifying costs. These incentives take the form of tax credits or tax relief against eligible R&D investment.  
  
R&D tax credits can reduce a company’s tax bill or, for some small and medium sized companies (SME’s), provide a cash sum. The tax credit allows companies to deduct up to 200% of qualifying R&D expenditure when calculating their profit for tax purposes. SME’s can, in certain circumstances, surrender the tax loss generated to claim a cash payment HM Revenue and Customs, which is a valuable source of funding for early-stage companies.  
  
We believe that technology based industries, a thriving science base and advanced manufacturing capabilities are essential to the future prosperity of the economy. This requires constant innovation and the R&D tax credit scheme is an important source of support for innovative projects.  
  
To date over £2 billion in support has been claimed by UK businesses, but this still represents a substantial shortfall on the R&D carried out in industry. Many companies are unaware that they qualify or believe that the claims process is onerous. Our aim is to provide the resources and technical expertise to enable all companies, to claim their full entitlement.

With a commitment to innovation, Ventura Foods produces over three billion pounds of finished goods annually, leveraging advanced manufacturing technologies across its 14 state-of-the-art plants and three culinary centers. The company also specializes in creating custom products, empowering chefs and restaurants to craft unique menu items that resonate with their customers.  
  
At the heart of Ventura Foods is a dedicated team of nearly 4,000 employees, who are nurtured through purposeful work, strong support, and opportunities for personal growth. As a values-driven organization, Ventura Foods emphasizes integrity, customer focus, teamwork, and personal ownership, ensuring that they deliver world-class service and products. Their mission is clear: to help their customers delight their customers, fostering a culture of excellence and passion for quality in every aspect of their operations. With revenues exceeding $2.5 billion, Ventura Foods continues to be a leader in the foodservice industry, committed to flavor, quality, and customer satisfaction.

At LUFRA, we take pride in our end-to-end process. From collecting milk directly from farmers to processing, packing, and distributing a diverse range of products, we ensure freshness and excellence. We offer a variety of packaging options, from family-sized packs to convenient "on the go" packages.  
  
Committed to the highest ISO standards, we have our own quality control department and specialized laboratory, ensuring uncompromising product quality. With a substantial market share in almost all our categories, we have become a trusted name in the industry.  
  
With approximately 350 dedicated employees, we foster a strong working culture and a "western mentality" that encourages learning and growth. We invest in our people through professional training and development facilitated by expert trainers. This, coupled with our absolute winning mindset, courage, and innovation, sets us apart from competitors.  
  
Having expanded into Kosovo and gaining FDA approval in 2021, we are actively exploring further regional markets. Join us as we continue our journey to deliver exceptional dairy products while making a global impact.

### Frequently Asked Questions about Tindle Construction, Inc.

What types of services does TCI Industrial Services offer?

TCI Industrial Services provides a wide range of specialized industrial services including maintenance, material removal, conveyor systems installation and repair, non-destructive testing, certified welding, crane and rigging services, ASME code piping, and ASME pressure vessel 'R' stamp repair. Our multi-divisional approach allows us to cater to various industrial needs with a focus on quality and reliability.

How does TCI ensure quality in its metal fabrication services?

At TCI, we adhere to the highest standards of quality in our metal fabrication processes. We utilize advanced technology and skilled personnel to ensure precision and durability in our products. Our commitment to quality is further demonstrated through our certifications and compliance with industry standards, ensuring that our clients receive reliable and high-quality solutions tailored to their specific needs.

What industries does TCI Industrial Services support?

TCI Industrial Services supports a diverse range of industries including manufacturing, construction, energy, and transportation. Our expertise in specialized industrial services allows us to meet the unique demands of each sector, providing tailored solutions that enhance operational efficiency and safety.

What is non-destructive testing and why is it important?

Non-destructive testing (NDT) is a method used to evaluate the properties of a material, component, or assembly without causing damage. TCI offers NDT services to ensure the integrity and reliability of structures and components, which is crucial for safety and compliance in industrial operations. By identifying potential issues before they become critical, NDT helps prevent costly repairs and downtime.

Can TCI assist with ASME code piping and pressure vessel repairs?

Yes, TCI Industrial Services specializes in ASME code piping and pressure vessel repairs, including those requiring the 'R' stamp certification. Our experienced team is trained to handle complex repairs while ensuring compliance with ASME standards, providing peace of mind to our clients regarding the safety and reliability of their systems.

What sets TCI apart from other industrial service providers?

TCI Industrial Services stands out due to its family-owned values, commitment to quality, and a comprehensive range of specialized services. Our experienced team is dedicated to delivering reliable solutions tailored to the unique needs of each client. We prioritize customer satisfaction and safety, ensuring that every project is completed to the highest standards in the industry.

MedQuest seeks to provide the best service, quality, care and value in diagnostic imaging. Service for us means customer service - treating each patient exactly how we ourselves would like our family and loved ones to be treated. Our affiliated physicians provide care on par with the finest medical institutions in the country. Each of our facilities is supported by Board Certified radiologists and a network of fellowship trained radiology specialists.

About Wick Buildings, LLC
-------------------------

Wick Buildings, Inc. is a privately held Wisconsin company founded in 1954 by John F. Wick. John Wick is a Wisconsin native and graduate of the University of Wisconsin–Madison with a background in agriculture and advanced schooling in business and engineering. In the early days, the post-frame buildings were used mainly on farms in the Midwest as replacement for the two-story dairy barn.  
  
Today, Wick Buildings consist of a wood-frame structure covered with sheet steel and/or other exterior materials such as brick and block. Clear span trusses up to 100 feet in width are fabricated. Siding, roofing, liners and trim are formed and cut from rolled steel at Wick’s production facilities. These components, together with the necessary pre-cut lumber, doors, windows and a variety of options, are loaded on semi-trailers and delivered to the buyer’s site. The components are then constructed into buildings on-site by company or local crews trained in the Wick way of building.  
  
About Us  
With the sale of over 70,000 buildings to date, Wick Buildings has steadily grown to become one of the nation’s largest producers of post-frame buildings, including sophisticated animal confinement systems, horse housing facilities, on-farm livestock and storage buildings, suburban structures and professionally engineered commercial and light industrial buildings.

What types of buildings does Wick Buildings, LLC specialize in?

Wick Buildings, LLC specializes in a wide range of building types, including commercial structures, warehouses, agricultural buildings, equestrian facilities, farm buildings, storage buildings, pole barns, suburban homes, storage sheds, cabins, and more. They also offer custom solutions for specific needs like beef and dairy facilities, equestrian riding arenas, hunting lodges, and even man-caves or she-sheds.

What is post-frame construction, and how does it benefit my building project?

Post-frame construction is a building method that uses large wooden posts as the primary structural support, allowing for wide-open spaces without the need for interior load-bearing walls. This technique offers several benefits, including faster construction times, cost-effectiveness, and flexibility in design. It is particularly well-suited for agricultural and commercial buildings, as it can accommodate large equipment and storage needs.

Can Wick Buildings help with custom designs for my specific needs?

Yes, Wick Buildings offers custom design services to meet the unique requirements of each client. Their experienced team works closely with customers to understand their vision and needs, whether it's for a residential home, an agricultural facility, or a commercial building. They utilize advanced design software to create tailored plans that maximize functionality and aesthetics.

What industries does Wick Buildings serve?

Wick Buildings serves a diverse range of industries, including agriculture, equestrian, commercial, and residential sectors. They provide solutions for farmers needing storage or livestock facilities, equestrian enthusiasts looking for riding arenas, and businesses requiring warehouses or office spaces. Their versatility allows them to cater to various building needs across multiple industries.

What are the advantages of choosing Wick Buildings for my construction project?

Choosing Wick Buildings offers several advantages, including their extensive experience since 1954, a strong reputation for quality craftsmanship, and a commitment to customer satisfaction. They provide comprehensive services from design to construction, ensuring that projects are completed on time and within budget. Additionally, their use of durable materials and innovative building techniques ensures long-lasting structures.

How can I get started with my building project through Wick Buildings?

To get started with your building project, you can visit the Wick Buildings website to explore their offerings and view project galleries. You can also contact their team directly via phone or email to discuss your specific needs and schedule a consultation. They will guide you through the process, from initial design ideas to final construction, ensuring a smooth experience.

The award-winning faculty at UNC Asheville are not only dedicated educators but also active researchers, ensuring that students benefit from a rich blend of academic expertise and real-world experience.  
  
One of the hallmarks of UNC Asheville is its nationally acclaimed undergraduate research program, which encourages students to engage in innovative projects that extend beyond traditional classroom learning. For those interested in the teaching staff, a comprehensive University of North Carolina Asheville teachers list is available, showcasing the diverse and accomplished faculty members who contribute to the university's vibrant academic community.  
  
In addition to its strong academic offerings, UNC Asheville is situated in a region known for its natural beauty and cultural richness, providing students with a unique backdrop for their educational journey. Whether through engaging in community service, participating in outdoor activities, or exploring the arts, students at UNC Asheville are encouraged to develop holistically, preparing them for successful futures in a variety of fields.

Food Lion is committed to providing an easy shopping experience that emphasizes affordability, freshness, and community engagement.  
  
The supermarket offers a wide range of products, including fresh produce, meats, dairy, bakery items, and household essentials, catering to the diverse needs of its customer base. Food Lion's commitment to quality is evident in its focus on fresh, locally sourced products, which not only supports local farmers but also enhances the shopping experience for customers seeking high-quality ingredients.  
  
In addition to its retail offerings, Food Lion is deeply invested in social responsibility through its Food Lion Feeds initiative, which aims to combat hunger in local communities. The company has pledged to donate 500 million meals through food donations, volunteer efforts, and various hunger-relief programs, showcasing its dedication to making a positive impact.  
  
To enhance operational efficiency and customer service, Food Lion leverages advanced technologies, including data analytics for inventory management and personalized marketing strategies. This focus on innovation ensures that Food Lion remains competitive in the grocery industry while continuing to meet the evolving needs of its customers. With a strong commitment to community and sustainability, Food Lion stands out as a leader in the grocery sector, dedicated to serving both its customers and the communities it calls home.

About Municipality of Rosario
-----------------------------

La ciudad de Rosario está ubicada en la zona sur de la provincia de Santa Fe, República Argentina, en una posición geoestratégica en relación con el Mercosur, en el extremo sur del continente americano.  
  
Limita al este con el río Paraná; al norte, con las localidades de Granadero Baigorria e Ibarlucea; al oeste, con las localidades de Funes y Pérez; y al sur, con las localidades de Soldini, Piñeiro y Villa Gobernador Gálvez. Los arroyos Ludueña al norte y Saladillo al sur cruzan el municipio de oeste a este y en algunos tramos también le sirven de límite.  
  
Cabecera del Departamento homónimo, la ciudad es el centro del Área Metropolitana Rosario y se sitúa a 300 km de la ciudad de Buenos Aires, ocupando una superficie total de 178,69 km2, de la cual la superficie urbanizada es de 120,37 km2.  
  
Rosario cuenta con 12,5 m² de espacio verde público por habitante. El espacio verde urbano se distribuye en 24 parques, 124 plazas, 51 plazoletas, 24 paseos y otros 228 espacios.  
  
En 1995 la ciudad comienza un proceso de descentralización administrativa. La ubicación de cada Centro Municipal de Distrito se encuadró en una estructuración general que contempló la construcción de estos relacionados entre sí, mediante vías de conexión de norte a sur que permitieron materializar el Nuevo Eje Metropolitano. La conformación de esta corona de CMDs tuvo una repercusión importante como operación de estructuración urbana general, al transformar e incorporar sectores relegados o periféricos para integrarlos a la vida de la ciudad.  
  
Su concreción implicó la apertura de grandes avenidas, la resolución de ciertos nudos viales de importancia, la creación de espacios públicos, comunitarios y de servicios, e inclusive en algunos sitios la construcción de nuevas viviendas.

.

¿Cuáles son los servicios que ofrece el Municipio de Rosario a los ciudadanos?

El Municipio de Rosario ofrece una amplia gama de servicios a los ciudadanos, que incluyen atención al ciudadano, gestión de trámites administrativos, servicios de salud, educación, seguridad, mantenimiento de espacios públicos, y promoción de actividades culturales y recreativas. Además, se implementan programas de desarrollo social y económico para mejorar la calidad de vida de los habitantes.

¿Cómo puedo realizar trámites administrativos en línea?

Para realizar trámites administrativos en línea, los ciudadanos pueden acceder al sitio web oficial del Municipio de Rosario, donde encontrarán una sección dedicada a 'Trámites en Línea'. Allí se pueden completar formularios, presentar solicitudes y consultar el estado de los trámites. Es importante contar con una cuenta de usuario para acceder a ciertos servicios.

¿Qué iniciativas tiene el Municipio de Rosario para el desarrollo sostenible?

El Municipio de Rosario ha implementado varias iniciativas para promover el desarrollo sostenible, incluyendo programas de reciclaje, gestión de residuos, y promoción de energías renovables. También se llevan a cabo proyectos de urbanismo sostenible que buscan mejorar la infraestructura urbana y fomentar el uso de transporte público y no motorizado.

¿Dónde puedo encontrar información sobre eventos culturales en Rosario?

La información sobre eventos culturales en Rosario se puede encontrar en la sección de 'Cultura' del sitio web del Municipio. Esta sección incluye un calendario de eventos, actividades artísticas, exposiciones y festivales que se realizan en la ciudad. También se pueden seguir las redes sociales del Municipio para estar al tanto de las novedades.

¿Qué programas de apoyo existen para emprendedores en Rosario?

El Municipio de Rosario ofrece varios programas de apoyo para emprendedores, que incluyen asesoramiento en la creación de negocios, acceso a financiamiento, capacitación y talleres. Además, se promueven espacios de coworking y ferias para que los emprendedores puedan exhibir sus productos y servicios. Para más información, los interesados pueden visitar la sección de 'Emprendimiento' en el sitio web.

¿Cómo puedo reportar problemas en mi barrio, como baches o falta de iluminación?

Los ciudadanos pueden reportar problemas en su barrio a través de la plataforma de 'Atención al Ciudadano' en el sitio web del Municipio de Rosario. Allí se puede completar un formulario para informar sobre baches, falta de iluminación, problemas de limpieza, entre otros. También se pueden realizar denuncias a través de la aplicación móvil del Municipio, que facilita la comunicación directa con las autoridades locales.

About Tirana Bank

Tirana Bank is the first privately owned bank in Albania. It was founded in 1996 and during this period there has been a great development, spreading its branches throughout Albania. Today, it is consolidated in the market, offering a wide range of products and services that respond well to the demands of its customers.  
Tirana Bank is a member of Balfin Group and operates in co-ordination with the Group's objectives and goals to become the leader in providing financial services. It continues to grow and expand, but rigorously retains its philosophy of delivering quality services and to be the frontrunner in providing new banking products to Albania. Many of the businesses in Albania see Tirana Bank as a permanent support point to invest and further develop their business.  
  
Today, Tirana Bank has 35 branches in the main cities and has a large ATM network throughout Albania. Customer service across the network is in professional standards and the client can find solutions for every requirement or financial need. Future objectives are closely related to "being close to the client" and this shows that it will continue to expand both geographically and in terms of quality products and services.  
  
Location and staff are the two key points of a bank to serve the customer better. Under this philosophy, Tirana Bank has created a staff of professionals with wide experience in the banking field, who devote their dedication to the success of the bank. Commitment to work, respect among colleagues, exchange of experiences and professional communication with the client are the best values of our Bank staff.  
The culture of our organization promotes creative spirit, co-operation, teamwork and merit reward, to achieve our primary goals and to successfully fulfill our mission.

Experiments on the F-22, F-35, and C-130 production lines all confirmed our belief that this technology could have a major impact on large-scale manufacturing in industrialized countries. Providing a technician with an AssemblyWorks System (rather than a stack of drawings and manuals) increases productivity in a similar way that providing a worker with a bulldozer (rather than a shovel) increases productivity. About Fallon Health
-------------------

Founded in 1977, Fallon Health is a community-focused not-for-profit health care services organization based in Worcester, Massachusetts. Committed to caring for those who need us most, we pride ourselves on providing coordinated, integrated care for older adults and for individuals with complex health needs. We serve as a provider of care through our Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly (PACE). Dedicated to delivering high quality health care, we are continually rated among the nation’s top health plans for member experience and service and clinical quality.  
  
Fallon Health focuses on health insurance products that serve older adults, lower-income individuals and individuals with complex health needs. We offer Medicare Advantage, Senior Care Options (SCO), MassHealth Accountable Care Organization (ACO) Partnership Plans, Programs of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly (PACE), and a limited number of products on the Massachusetts Health Connector, including ConnectorCare.  
  
Fallon Health has two Programs of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly (PACE), alternatives to nursing homes that provide older adults and their caregivers innovative health care and support. In Massachusetts, Fallon Health offers Summit ElderCare. In New York, Fallon offers Fallon Health Weinberg–PACE in partnership with the Weinberg Campus.  
  
Since its inception in 1977, Fallon Health has worked to improve the quality of life and the health status of the diverse communities we serve. Our community engagement efforts are driven by the needs of the community and fueled by a deep commitment to the mission of Fallon Health.  
  
We support programs that promote equitable health care and social services.  
  
We also think community service is so important that we encourage our employees to volunteer. Fallon invites employees to volunteer one day per year, on company time.

About The Primary School
------------------------

We are creating a new school model that brings together all of the adults in a child’s life, including parents, educators, and medical and mental health providers, starting from a very early age. Our aim is that children and families most impacted by systemic poverty and racism receive the support they deserve to be well, learn, and thrive.  
  
Three key components make up our unique approach:  
  
We start early: We start working with parents and enroll children into our program as early as birth to reach them at their most critical stage in development.  
  
We work with - not around - families: We know that parents and caregivers are the most important people in a child’s life. We partner with them to enhance the education and health of their children.  
  
We integrate multiple systems to serve the whole child: Our unique model unites health care and education, building a multi-disciplinary team and holistic system of care around a child’s full needs.  
  
Our ultimate goal is to create a game-changing system of care for children that can be replicated across the country. To that end, we are building a model that can be effectively implemented in diverse communities and sustained on public funding.  
  
We currently operate two program sites in East Palo Alto and East Bay, California, which act as our primary centers of direct impact, innovation, and learning.

About WB Engineers+Consultants
------------------------------

Communicator. Client advocate. Business person’s engineer. These aren’t typical descriptions for engineers, but they are all great ways to describe us. Since our first day of business in October 1999, and on the hundreds of projects we’ve completed, we help our clients make good business decisions about their systems and spaces. We take complex engineering information and make it easy to understand – so that they in turn can make smart decisions.  
  
We started our business during the height of the dot com boom. The internet age set new industry expectations for design projects: schedules were especially tight; a majority of the overall project cost, the MEP engineering and installation had a direct impact on a company’s bottom line; and clients wanted to be informed about the status their project at all times. With an efficient project approach, and having a team that is both great at communication and thoughtful of our client’s business, we thrived in this new business environment. While the dot com boom didn’t last, it shaped the way we do business – even today – in a very successful way.  
  
IMPROVING THE WAY THINGS ARE DONE™  
We have a talented team of over 150 professionals, well educated in their respective disciplines and many with great credentials behind their names. Beyond that, Improving the Way Things are Done is important to who we are as a company. We are always thinking about ways to use technology more effectively, design more efficiently, and communicate better.

Does Mark Farrah Associates provide consulting services?

About Fabricators and Manufacturers Association
-----------------------------------------------

The Fabricators & Manufacturers Association, International (FMA) is a professional organization with more than 2,500 individual and company members working together to improve the metal processing, forming, and fabricating industry. Membership spans the United States, Canada and Mexico, and reaches into more than 30 other countries.  
  
FMA brings metal fabricators and equipment manufacturers together through technology councils, educational programs, networking events, and the FABTECH®, the industry's leading trade show. The official publications of FMA include - The FABRICATOR®, The Tube & Pipe Journal®, STAMPING Journal®, The WELDER®, The Fabricator® en Espanol, Canadian Metalworking, and Canadian Fabricating & Welding.  
  
FMA also has two technology affiliates, the Tube & Pipe Association, International (TPA) which focuses on the unique needs of members involved in production and fabrication of welded and seamless pipe and tube and the Association of Steel Distributors (ASD) which serves professionals in the steel distribution industry  
  
FMA’s charitable foundation, Nuts, Bolts & Thingamajigs®, provides grants to community and technical colleges to produce manufacturing summer camps for youth ages 12-16 to introduce them to manufacturing career options. The foundation provides scholarships for qualified students in post-secondary educational programs leading to careers in manufacturing as well.  
  
FMA is also a co-founder of Manufacturing Day, a national movement dedicated to addressing common misconceptions about manufacturing by giving manufacturers an opportunity to open their doors and show, in a coordinated effort, what modern manufacturing is.

What types of services does PMK•BNC offer?

PMK•BNC offers a wide range of services including experiential marketing, event marketing, public relations, strategic partnerships, influencer marketing, and entertainment marketing. Our expertise extends to promotions, sponsorships, media relations, film distribution, insights and analytics, product placement, and talent and brand procurement. We focus on enhancing client relationships with consumers through engaging experiences in the realms of entertainment, sports, music, and fashion.

How does PMK•BNC approach experiential marketing?

PMK•BNC approaches experiential marketing by creating immersive and engaging experiences that connect brands with their target audiences. We leverage the passion points of entertainment and culture to design events and campaigns that resonate with consumers. Our team collaborates closely with clients to understand their goals and tailor experiences that not only promote products but also foster emotional connections with fans and communities.

What industries does PMK•BNC serve?

PMK•BNC serves a diverse range of industries including entertainment, sports, fashion, and music. Our expertise allows us to cater to clients across various sectors, helping them leverage popular culture to enhance their brand visibility and consumer engagement. Whether it's through strategic partnerships or innovative marketing campaigns, we aim to support our clients in achieving their business objectives within these dynamic industries.

Can PMK•BNC assist with influencer marketing campaigns?

Yes, PMK•BNC specializes in influencer marketing campaigns. We have established relationships with a wide network of influencers across different platforms and industries. Our team works with clients to identify the right influencers who align with their brand values and target audience. We develop strategic campaigns that leverage these influencers to amplify brand messages, drive engagement, and ultimately enhance consumer relationships.

What is PMK•BNC's approach to public relations?

PMK•BNC's approach to public relations is centered around storytelling and building meaningful relationships. We craft compelling narratives that resonate with target audiences and utilize a variety of media channels to disseminate these stories. Our team focuses on media relations, crisis management, and reputation building to ensure our clients maintain a positive public image while effectively communicating their brand values and messages.

How does PMK•BNC measure the success of its marketing campaigns?

PMK•BNC employs a data-driven approach to measure the success of its marketing campaigns. We utilize insights and analytics to track key performance indicators (KPIs) such as engagement rates, reach, and conversion metrics. By analyzing this data, we can assess the effectiveness of our strategies, make informed adjustments, and provide clients with comprehensive reports that highlight the impact of our campaigns on their business objectives.

David Brooks is not your typical commentator. What sets Brooks apart is his deep understanding of the human condition. He aims to unravel the complex web of human emotions and motivations underlying societal issues. Through his poignant narratives, he invites readers into introspective journeys. Brooks effortlessly combines his own personal experiences with astute observations to offer a fresh perspective on the challenges facing our nation.  
  
As an op-ed columnist for The New York Times, Brooks fearlessly tackles controversial topics with nuance and precision. He doesn't shy away from challenging the status quo, as he believes that true progress can only come from rigorous intellectual exploration and open dialogue. Rather than resorting to inflammatory rhetoric, he emphasizes the importance of listening to others, even when they hold opposing views.

He effortlessly weaves together history, social science, and philosophy to provide a comprehensive understanding of the subjects he delves into. Brooks encourages readers to reevaluate their priorities and reflect on what truly matters, reminding them of the importance of cultivating moral virtues.  
  
Brooks is not one to confine himself to the political realm; he effortlessly moves between analyzing policy to dissecting cultural trends. He understands that politics is not an isolated pursuit but rather deeply intertwined with society. Whether he's contemplating the decline of empathy or the impact of technology on human connection, Brooks always brings a fresh perspective, forcing readers to consider the broader implications of our collective choices.  
  
One of the reasons why Brooks resonates with such a diverse audience is his ability to strike a balance between reason and compassion. He acknowledges the complexity of issues while demonstrating empathy for those affected by them. This unique combination allows him to inject humanity into his writing, making it relatable and engaging for readers from all walks of life.  
  
In an era marked by partisan polarization, Brooks remains a steadfast advocate for respectful dialogue and understanding. He encourages readers to seek common ground, challenging the prevailing narratives that divide us. With his optimistic outlook and sincere curiosity, Brooks offers a glimmer of hope in a world often overshadowed by cynicism.  
  
In essence, David Brooks is more than just an American commentator; he is a voice that elevates the discourse and encourages introspection. Variations in care cost the healthcare industry trillions of dollars annually. And the cost to patients is no less concerning. In this climate of variability, Wolters Kluwer Health solutions deliver clarity when and where it matters most — so every patient benefits from the best knowledge and evidence. Our solutions engage clinicians making decisions about care, healthcare leaders paving the road to value-based care, patients taking a more active role in their health, researchers defining the cutting edge of medicine, and students preparing to become the next generation of healthcare providers. By providing meaningful insight and context to the people who need it most – at the most opportune time – Wolters Kluwer Health solutions reduce the variability that stands in the way of effective care.  
  
Every day around the world, healthcare professionals, students, and researchers are making important decisions using our trusted medical evidence and technology solutions through familiar names, such as Lippincott , Ovid® UpToDate®, Medi-Span®, Health Language, Sentri7®, POC Advisor and Simplifi 797®, and Emmi.

About Biev
----------

1984 yılında açılan ilk züccaciye mağazası ile temelleri atılan Biev, doğuşu sayılabilecek bu ilk adımdan sonra ev - yaşam kültürünün gelişmesi ve zenginleşmesi yönünde sürdürdüğü çalışmaları ve yarattığı öncü markalarının ardından 2007 yılında kuruldu.  
  
Biev, kendisine ait mağazaları, franchise mağazaları ve online alışveriş sitesi ile seçkin bayi ve satış noktalarında kişiye özel ve keyifli alışveriş deneyimi sunarken, ev-yaşam trendlerine yön veren yenilikçi bakış açısı ile sıcak ve huzurlu alanlar yaratıyor.  
Hayattaki duruşunu, motivasyon kaynaklarını evi ile paylaşanlara yönelik mobilyadan aksesuara, aydınlatmadan ev tekstil grubuna geniş bir yelpazede dekorasyona dair pek çok farklı tarz ile müşterilerine yaratıcılıklarını ortaya çıkaracak fikirler sunan Biev, bugün milyonlarca evde dekorasyon zenginliği yaratıyor.  
  
‘’Hayalinizdeki gibi Biev’’ mottosu ile kendi stilini yaşam alanlarına yansıtanların vazgeçilmezi olan Biev, özgün bakış açısı, trendlere göre şekillendirdiği ürün çeşidi ve dekorasyona yönelik yaratıcı fikirlerinin yanı sıra güçlü marka kimliği ile dünya markası olma yolunda ilerlemeye devam ediyor.  
  
  
Founded in 2007, Biev’s ongoing efforts to develop and enrich a home and lifestyle culture by giving birth to pioneering brands dates back all the way to its first glassware store in 1984.  
While providing the pleasure of customized shopping experience for consumers both at its branded stores and select dealers, sales points, franchise stores and online shopping sites as well, Biev, with an innovative approach, creates heartwarming and peaceful living spaces and leads the way to home and lifestyle trends. Biev offers products and collections ranging from furniture to accessories, from lightning to home textile in almost every line of decoration to nurture the creativity of consumers who like reflecting their character to the living environment and so to create rich decorative atmospheres in millions of homes.  
  
With a unique vision, a strong brand identity, a product range of the latest trends and creative ideas for decorating, Biev marches towards being a world brand and continues to be indispensable for people who like reflecting their personal style to living spaces with the motto “Your Dream Home” in their mind.

What types of relocation services does GoodGuide offer?

GoodGuide provides a comprehensive range of relocation services tailored to meet the needs of both individuals and organizations. Our offerings include pre-departure consultations, visa and immigration assistance, home search services, school search for families, settling-in services, and ongoing support for expatriates. We aim to ensure a smooth transition for employees relocating to the Netherlands.

How does GoodGuide support international employees during their relocation process?

GoodGuide supports international employees by offering personalized services that address their unique needs. This includes assistance with understanding local customs, navigating housing options, enrolling children in schools, and connecting with local communities. Our dedicated team is available to provide guidance and support throughout the entire relocation process, ensuring a seamless experience for both the employee and their family.

Can GoodGuide assist with temporary housing solutions?

Yes, GoodGuide can assist with temporary housing solutions for employees who need a place to stay while they search for permanent accommodation. We have partnerships with local housing providers and can help secure short-term rentals, serviced apartments, or hotels that meet the specific needs of the relocating employee.

What industries does GoodGuide primarily serve?

GoodGuide serves a variety of industries, focusing on sectors that frequently require global mobility solutions. Our primary clients include technology, finance, healthcare, and education sectors. We understand the unique challenges faced by these industries and tailor our services to support their workforce relocation needs effectively.

How does GoodGuide ensure a smooth settling-in process for relocated employees?

GoodGuide ensures a smooth settling-in process by providing a range of services designed to help employees acclimate to their new environment. This includes cultural orientation sessions, local area tours, assistance with setting up utilities and banking, and connecting them with local networks. Our goal is to make the transition as comfortable and stress-free as possible, allowing employees to focus on their new roles.

Is GoodGuide's service available for both individuals and companies?

Yes, GoodGuide's services are available for both individuals and companies. We work with organizations looking to relocate their employees as part of their global talent strategy, as well as providing direct support to individuals and families relocating to the Netherlands. Our flexible approach allows us to cater to the specific needs of both groups effectively.

Our highly accomplished Certified Meeting Professionals and in-house catering and banquet team are all well-equipped to craft solutions for any size meeting or conference.  
  
This St. Louis, Missouri hotel presents a dynamic new vision and perspective of lodging, coupled with the legacy of flawless Hilton service. Inside - a world class hotel, outside - a field of dreams.

The mission is to be Brevard's leader in mobilizing the caring power of our community.  
  
United Way of Brevard County was started in 1957 by a group of concerned individuals wanting to help those in need. They formed the Brevard County United Appeal and conducted their first county-wide fund drive in the early spring of 1958. Over $104,000 was raised, and 12 agencies received funding that first year.  
The annual campaign has grown over the years highlighted by the recent 2021 campaign, which raised over $5.6 million and supported more than 60 programs at 43 agencies.

About Johnson Outdoors
----------------------

Johnson Outdoors is a leader in innovative outdoor recreational equipment for fishing, diving, camping and watercraft recreation enthusiasts. Founded in 1970 by Samuel C. Johnson, the Company evolved from a single brand into a $425 million global enterprise with 1,200 employees across 20 facilities worldwide. Public offerings of Johnson Outdoors (JOUT: Nasdaq) occurred in 1987 and 1988, with the Johnson family maintaining a controlling ownership position.  
  
Johnson Outdoors designs, manufactures and markets many of the world's best known outdoor recreation brands across four business units: Fishing, Diving, Watercraft Recreation, Camping and Hiking. Our legacy of success is built on continuous, award-winning innovation which drives market-leading positions across 16 product categories. For over ten consecutive years, new products have represented a third or more of total Company revenue. Our mission is "to exceed the ever-growing expectations of outdoor enthusiasts, and the channel customers that serve them, with the most innovative, most valued and most sought-after brands and equipment."​ Investments will focus on sustaining leadership in fishing electronics, maintaining positive momentum in core dive equipment segments, driving growth in specialty camping and paddling channels and maximizing opportunities to improve the long-term profitability profile of every business.  
  
At Johnson Outdoors, we believe creating value goes beyond creating great products into creating the ultimate outdoor experience for outdoor enthusiasts. Our portfolio of market-winning brands is known for delivering on that promise.  
  
• Minn Kota® motors and accessories; Humminbird® fishfinders, maps and charts; Cannon® downriggers  
• SCUBAPRO® dive equipment and computers  
• Eureka!® tents and camping gear; Jetboil® personal cooking systems

.

What types of construction services does U.S. Construction Corp. offer?

U.S. Construction Corp. specializes in a variety of construction services, including Design-Build, Construction Management, General Contracting, Fast Track Construction, and Complex Facilities Construction. This diverse range of services allows us to cater to different project needs, ensuring that we can deliver high-quality results tailored to our clients' specifications.

What industries does U.S. Construction Corp. serve?

U.S. Construction Corp. serves a wide array of industries, including commercial, residential, healthcare, education, and hospitality. Our extensive experience across these sectors enables us to understand the unique challenges and requirements of each industry, allowing us to provide customized solutions that meet our clients' goals.

How does the Design-Build process work at U.S. Construction Corp.?

The Design-Build process at U.S. Construction Corp. integrates both design and construction services into a single contract. This streamlined approach fosters collaboration between architects, engineers, and contractors, resulting in improved communication, reduced project timelines, and cost savings. Our team works closely with clients from the initial concept through to project completion, ensuring that their vision is realized efficiently.

What is Fast Track Construction, and how can it benefit my project?

Fast Track Construction is a project delivery method that allows for overlapping design and construction phases to expedite the overall timeline. At U.S. Construction Corp., we utilize this approach to help clients meet tight deadlines without compromising quality. By starting construction before the design is fully completed, we can significantly reduce project duration, making it an ideal solution for urgent projects.

Can U.S. Construction Corp. handle complex facilities construction?

Yes, U.S. Construction Corp. has extensive experience in managing complex facilities construction projects. Our skilled team is equipped to tackle the unique challenges presented by such projects, including regulatory compliance, advanced technology integration, and specialized construction techniques. We prioritize meticulous planning and execution to ensure that complex projects are completed on time and within budget.

How can I get a quote for my construction project with U.S. Construction Corp.?

To obtain a quote for your construction project, you can reach out to U.S. Construction Corp. through our website or by contacting our office directly. We encourage you to provide detailed information about your project, including scope, timeline, and budget. Our team will review your requirements and schedule a consultation to discuss your needs further, ensuring that we provide an accurate and competitive quote.

About United Community Housing Coalition
----------------------------------------

United Community Housing Coalition (UCHC) is a 501(c)3 nonprofit organization, which provides comprehensive housing assistance to Detroit’s low-income residents. Since 1973, the organization has worked with tenants, homesteaders, homeowners, the homeless and community organizations, rebuilding neighborhoods and providing affordable housing, religious, civil rights, labor and housing advocacy to improve, preserve and expand affordable housing opportunities for low-income Detroiters. Today, the organization is primarily focused on the following areas of work: landlord tenant legal counseling, housing placement, tenant organizing, and tax and mortgage foreclosure prevention. Services are provided to income-eligible families and individuals free of charge.

About OncoDrex
--------------

OncoDrex is a biotech company developing early screening and diagnostics for cancer.  
OncoDrex's lead product is a novel blood test for the early detection and screening of colorectal cancer.  
  
There is an urgent unmet need to develop a technology that uses blood for the detection of colorectal cancer. VastCon’s lead technology is a novel blood test for early detection and screening of colorectal cancer. This technology is based on the discovery of two biomarkers that are present in high concentrations in the peripheral blood of CRC patients and not healthy subjects. In an initial preclinical study, OncoDrex found that the test was highly sensitive and specific to colorectal cancer.  
  
This test has the potential to replace currently existing fecal occult blood test (FOBT) by cost effectiveness, higher sensitivity and reliability for the detection of CRC at an early stage. Due to the unpleasantness of FOBT, the compliance rate is very low. Moreover, FOBT detects the presence of blood in faecal matter, which could be due to several factors apart from CRC introducing unreliability and non-specificity into the picture.  
  
  
  
OncoDrex's aim is to grow into a multinational company developing diagnostics for cancers of many types.

TheGrio News stands at the forefront of amplifying African American voices and narratives that are often overlooked by mainstream media. Its commitment to providing a platform for diverse perspectives is particularly evident in its key projects, such as the feature-length documentary "Meeting David Wilson." Through his exploration of family history, Wilson not only seeks to understand his own identity but also engages with the broader implications of America’s racial divide. This documentary aligns seamlessly with TheGrio’s mission, as it highlights the importance of storytelling in fostering dialogue and understanding within the African American community. TheGrio’s expertise in video production and journalism is evident in the high-quality content it produces, including original video packages and blogs that resonate with its audience. By leveraging skills in public relations, social networking, and editing, TheGrio effectively engages its community, ensuring that their stories are told with authenticity and depth. As a leader in the digital media landscape, TheGrio continues to be a vital resource for those seeking to navigate the complexities of race, identity, and history in America today.

What types of educational programs does NAED offer?

NAED offers a variety of educational programs designed to enhance the skills and knowledge of professionals in the electrical distribution industry. NAED actively engages in government advocacy to represent the interests of electrical distributors at local, state, and federal levels. NAED also collaborates with other industry organizations to amplify its advocacy efforts.

These events provide members with the opportunity to connect with peers, share experiences, and build relationships that can lead to collaboration and business growth. Networking is a key component of NAED's mission to foster a strong community within the electrical distribution industry.

How can I access NAED's white papers and research reports?

About Mended Hearts
-------------------

Mended Hearts is the oldest and largest cardiovascular peer-to-peer support network in the world. This community-based non-profit organization has been offering the gift of hope to heart disease patients, their families and caregivers for 71 years.  
  
Mended Hearts’ 72,000 members visit more than 200,000 patients each year in 460 hospitals and rehab centers. With 285 chapters in North America, the organization provides patient visiting program, education, support group meetings and online communities. Our peer support groups help patients and their families understand that there can be a rich, rewarding life after a heart disease diagnosis.  
  
To learn more, request support or to find a chapter in your area, visit www.mendedhearts.org or call 888-432-7899.  
  
Mended Little Hearts works nationally and in communities to support the families of children born with congenital heart defects. Visit www.mendedlittlehearts.org or call 888-432-7899 for more information.  
  
Young Mended Hearts is a safe place for people between the ages of 18 and 55 to talk about their fears and share their successes. Young Mended Hearts can make a tremendous difference in the lives of young adults living with heart disease.
