About Phoenix Specialty Mfg. Co.
--------------------------------

The Industry Leader in Small Specialty Stampings.  
  
Since 1907, Phoenix Specialty has made sourcing specialty components easy for customers in every industry imaginable. We are the leading supplier of custom parts to America’s Original Equipment Manufacturers and the only company offering a written Risk-Free Guarantee. We promise to:  
  
\- Deliver parts on time, every time.  
\- Supply the highest-quality parts exactly to customer specifications.  
\- Maintain a one-year price lock.  
\- Eliminate supply chain risk.  
  
We specialize in “custom,” and we have the ability to manufacture your parts – in low to medium volumes – with tolerances down to .0005” thick. Never a tooling charge, or additional hidden fees – guaranteed! If you need a custom part, send us your blueprint and we will have it to you FAST. We are the fastest in the industry, and that’s why “Specialty” is our middle name.  
  
Customers searching for shorter lead times and increased savings can find peace of mind by participating in Phoenix’s Managed Inventory System. Same-day shipping means you can have your parts as early as tomorrow.  
  
With a long history of stability and growth, we remain committed to serving our customers. Nobody works harder or faster to deliver high-quality, precision parts – all made in the USA.

About Luxus Limited
-------------------

Luxus is one of the UK’s leading technical plastics recycling and compounding companies. Since its establishment in 1965, Luxus has built on nearly half a century’s knowledge and investment. Based in Louth Lincolnshire, its modern manufacturing facility now occupies a covered area of 28,328 square meters. It uses ‘state of the art’ technologies to deliver highly specified thermoplastic compounds based on recycled and prime feedstocks.  
Luxus was the first and is still the only independent UK based company to achieve approval of its recycled grades for the global automotive industry. It has continued to push the boundaries thanks to its Technical Centre created in 1982, that offers polymer development, testing and analysis services. Luxus technicians skillfully manufacture highly specified sustainable products from plastic scrap material to meet a broad range of applications for the automotive; wheel bin; logistics transit packaging; construction and electronics markets.  
On going investment in R & D enables it to remain at the forefront of polymer technology, offering bespoke solutions for both general industry and niche highly specified applications.  
Luxus considers itself the originator of the ‘art, science and technology’ of sustainable plastics recycling and is the strategic partner of choice for major global blue chip clients.

About MyChild'sCancer
---------------------

MyChild'sCancer (MCC) is an international nonprofit (501c3) organization that provides personalized treatment research, patient advocacy, and varied community support services to predominantly Jewish and Israeli families battling childhood cancer.  
  
Our Vision is that no child should perish because life-saving information was not available to h/her parents or caregivers. Our Mission is to make life-saving information on treatment options, emerging clinical trails, specialists, and new drugs easily accessible to families during their fight against childhood cancer.  
  
PROGRAMS  
  
Individualized, situational pediatric cancer treatment research: Childhood cancer is extremely rare but because of this, parents often struggle to find information that could save their child's life. MCC's team of cancer experts, medical researchers, and Oncologists provides personalized research into treatment methodologies, new drugs, specialists, hospitals, and emerging clinical trials.  
  
General patient advocacy: MCC conducts continual outreach to relevant national and international treatment centers, hospitals, doctors, nurses, and insurance providers in order to ensure our families get the best care possible. MCC facilitates second options, joins families on medical visits, works with health care providers, translates medical documentation if necessary, straightens out payment and health insurance issues, and works to ensure each family is informed, supported, and can focus on the needs of their child.  
  
Community support services: MCC provides information, guidance and relocation assistance to families traveling from Israel to the United States for treatment. MCC is building the 'Wikipedia' of childhood cancer because asking your doctor the right question may save your child's life.

About Mandalay Bay Resort and Casino
------------------------------------

Mandalay Bay Resort and Casino, an AAA Four Diamond Award-winning destination, is a lush, tropical oasis located on the iconic Las Vegas Strip. Spanning 120 acres, this vibrant resort immerses guests in a paradise-like atmosphere, featuring intricately carved stone statues, cascading waterfalls, and a stunning Valley of the Falls that sets the stage for unforgettable experiences. Upon entering, visitors are greeted by a breathtaking 14-foot-high saltwater aquarium, home to a diverse array of marine life, including leopard sharks and colorful angelfish, reminiscent of the South Pacific's coral reefs.  
  
Mandalay Bay offers a wide range of services and amenities, catering to leisure and business travelers alike. The resort boasts a vast casino floor, luxurious accommodations, and an array of dining options, from casual eateries to fine dining experiences. Guests can indulge in relaxation at the Mandalay Bay Beach, a 11-acre aquatic playground featuring a wave pool, lazy river, and sandy beach, or rejuvenate at the spa and wellness center.  
  
For those seeking a more tranquil retreat, Delano Las Vegas provides a boutique-style, all-suite experience with its own entrance and amenities, while the Four Seasons Hotel Las Vegas occupies the upper floors of Mandalay Bay, offering an exclusive experience with elegant rooms, fine dining, and a private pool. With cutting-edge technology and exceptional service, Mandalay Bay continues to be a premier destination in the hospitality industry, attracting visitors from around the globe to experience its unique blend of excitement and serenity.

About South Street Seaport Museum
---------------------------------

South Street Seaport Museum is a non-profit cultural institution preserving and promoting the historic district of South Street Seaport in New York City. Founded on May 22, 1967, the South Street Seaport Museum (SSSM) is dedicated to telling the vital story of the foundation of New York and its link to its great natural harbor.  
  
The museum preserves and interprets the history of New York City as a place where goods, labor and cultures are exchanged through work, commerce, and the interaction of diverse communities. Designated by Congress as America’s National Maritime Museum in 1998, SSSM is located in a 12 square-block historic district on the East River in Lower Manhattan, the site of the original port of New York City.  
  
The Museum is comprised of key historic locations on Schermerhorn Row, Water Street, and on the “Street of Ships” at Pier 16. These exhibitions and educational facilities are located in the South Street Seaport in New York City’s largest concentration of restored early nineteenth century commercial buildings.  
  
The Museum houses exhibition galleries, a working nineteenth century print shop, an archaeology center, a maritime library, a craft center, a marine life conservation lab, and the largest privately-owned fleet of historic ships in the country.

What types of services does Oak-Leyden Developmental Services offer for individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities?

Oak-Leyden Developmental Services provides a wide range of services tailored to meet the needs of children and adults with intellectual and developmental disabilities. These services include individualized therapy, early intervention programs, supported employment opportunities, educational services, housing solutions, and comprehensive family support. Each service is designed to promote independence, enhance quality of life, and support personal growth.

How does Oak-Leyden approach early intervention for children with developmental delays?

Oak-Leyden's early intervention program focuses on providing support and resources to children from birth to age three who are experiencing developmental delays. The program includes personalized assessments, therapy sessions, and family education to help children reach their developmental milestones. By collaborating with families and utilizing evidence-based practices, Oak-Leyden aims to foster positive outcomes and empower families during this critical period.

What job placement services does Oak-Leyden offer for adults with disabilities?

Oak-Leyden offers supported employment services that assist adults with intellectual and developmental disabilities in finding and maintaining meaningful employment. This includes job coaching, skills training, and ongoing support to ensure individuals can thrive in their work environments. The program emphasizes personalized job matching based on individual strengths and interests, helping participants achieve greater independence and self-sufficiency.

Can families access housing solutions through Oak-Leyden for their loved ones with disabilities?

Yes, Oak-Leyden provides various housing solutions for individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities. This includes group homes and supported living arrangements that promote independence while ensuring a safe and supportive environment. Families can work with Oak-Leyden to explore options that best fit their loved ones' needs, preferences, and goals, ensuring a comfortable living situation that fosters personal growth.

How does Oak-Leyden support families of individuals with developmental disabilities?

Oak-Leyden recognizes the challenges faced by families of individuals with developmental disabilities and offers comprehensive support services. This includes family education programs, counseling, and access to community resources. By providing information, training, and emotional support, Oak-Leyden aims to empower families, helping them navigate the complexities of caregiving and advocate for their loved ones effectively.

What is the process for enrolling in services at Oak-Leyden Developmental Services?

To enroll in services at Oak-Leyden, interested individuals or families should first contact the organization to discuss their specific needs. An intake assessment will be conducted to evaluate eligibility and determine the most appropriate services. Following the assessment, a personalized service plan will be developed in collaboration with the individual and their family, ensuring that the services provided align with their goals and preferences.
